title: HR Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced and proactive HR Manager to manage the complete human resources and administrative functions of our facility management company. The candidate will be responsible for manpower planning, recruitment, employee relations, attendance, payroll coordination, compliance, and ensuring smooth HR operations across various client sites.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of managing housekeeping, security, maintenance, technical, and supervisory staff deployed at multiple locations.

Key Responsibilities1\. Recruitment \& Manpower Planning

* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for housekeeping, security, maintenance, technical, and administrative positions.
* Coordinate with operations teams to understand manpower requirements.
* Source, screen, interview, and onboard suitable candidates.
* Ensure timely deployment of employees at client sites.
* Maintain a talent pool for urgent manpower requirements.

2\. Employee Management

* Manage employee joining, documentation, induction, confirmation, transfers, and exits.
* Maintain accurate employee records and personnel files.
* Address employee grievances and workplace concerns.
* Ensure proper communication of company policies and procedures.
* Coordinate employee engagement and welfare activities.

3\. Attendance \& Payroll Coordination

* Monitor attendance, shift schedules, weekly offs, and leave records.
* Coordinate monthly payroll processing with the accounts team.
* Verify overtime, incentives, salary deductions, and site\-wise manpower records.
* Resolve attendance and salary\-related employee queries.
* Ensure accurate deployment and attendance reports are maintained.

4\. Statutory Compliance \& Labour Laws

* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and employment regulations.
* Coordinate PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, Bonus, Gratuity, and other applicable statutory requirements.
* Maintain employee documentation and compliance records.
* Coordinate with consultants and authorities for statutory matters.
* Ensure proper implementation of workplace policies.

5\. Site HR Operations

* Conduct regular visits to client sites to monitor employee welfare and HR\-related concerns.
* Coordinate with site supervisors and operations managers regarding manpower issues.
* Manage absenteeism, attrition, replacement manpower, and employee discipline.
* Ensure employees follow company rules and client\-site requirements.
* Support smooth manpower mobilization for new contracts and projects.

6\. Performance \& Disciplinary Management

* Monitor employee performance in coordination with operations teams.
* Issue warnings and notices for misconduct, absenteeism, and policy violations when required.
* Handle disciplinary procedures professionally and fairly.
* Support performance appraisals and employee development initiatives.

7\. HR Policies \& Administration

* Develop and implement HR policies, SOPs, and employee guidelines.
* Prepare HR reports, manpower MIS, attrition reports, and attendance summaries.
* Manage HR documentation, employee databases, and administrative activities.
* Support management in workforce planning and organizational development.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* MBA / PGDM in HR preferred.
* 4–8 years of relevant experience in HR management.
* Experience in facility management, housekeeping, security services, or manpower outsourcing preferred.
* Strong knowledge of recruitment, payroll, attendance, and labour compliance.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to manage large teams across multiple client locations.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, HRMS, and reporting tools.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely fulfilment of manpower requirements.
* Employee retention and reduction in attrition.
* Accurate attendance and payroll coordination.
* Timely resolution of employee grievances.
* Statutory compliance and documentation accuracy.
* Effective site\-level HR coordination.

title: Outlet Supervisor
description:
To manage the day\-to\-day operations of the outlet, ensure smooth business operations, achieve sales targets, maintain customer satisfaction, and ensure proper staff, stock, cash, hygiene, and operational controls.

\#\#\# Key Responsibilities

\*\*1\. Outlet Operations\*\*

\* Manage the overall daily operations of the outlet.

\* Ensure the outlet opens and closes on time.

\* Maintain proper cleanliness, hygiene, and presentation.

\* Ensure all operational procedures and company guidelines are followed.

\* Coordinate with the Area Manager and Head Office for operational requirements.

\*\*2\. Sales \& Business\*\*

\* Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets.

\* Monitor outlet sales and identify opportunities to improve revenue.

\* Promote cakes, pastries, beverages, and other products.

\* Follow up on customer orders and corporate/bulk orders.

\* Monitor product movement and minimize sales loss.

\*\*3\. Staff Management\*\*

\* Allocate duties and shifts to outlet staff.

\* Monitor staff attendance, punctuality, grooming, and performance.

\* Train and guide staff on customer service and outlet procedures.

\* Manage staff discipline and report serious issues to the Area Manager/HR.

\* Ensure sufficient manpower during peak hours.

\*\*4\. Stock Management\*\*

\* Monitor daily stock levels and product availability.

\* Check incoming stock against invoices/delivery documents.

\* Maintain proper stock rotation using FIFO.

\* Monitor wastage, damages, shortages, and expiry.

\* Raise stock requirements on time to avoid product shortages.

\*\*5\. Cash \& Billing\*\*

\* Ensure proper billing and cash\-handling procedures.

\* Verify daily cash collection and submit reports as per company procedure.

\* Monitor card/UPI/online payments and report discrepancies immediately.

\* Ensure discounts, refunds, and complimentary purchases are processed only with proper authorization.

\*\*6\. Customer Service\*\*

\* Ensure excellent customer service at all times.

\* Handle customer complaints professionally and resolve issues within authority.

\* Collect customer feedback and communicate important issues to management.

\* Maintain proper customer interaction and outlet standards.

\*\*7\. Hygiene \& Food Safety\*\*

\* Ensure the outlet maintains required hygiene and food\-safety standards.

\* Check product display, storage temperature, expiry dates, and cleanliness.

\* Ensure staff follow proper personal hygiene and grooming standards.

\* Immediately report any food\-quality or safety concerns.

\*\*8\. Reporting \& Documentation\*\*

\* Submit daily sales and operational reports.

\* Maintain attendance, stock, wastage, cash, and other required records.

\* Report outlet issues related to equipment, maintenance, manpower, stock, or sales.

\* Coordinate with accounts, HR, production, delivery, and other departments when required.

\#\#\# Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

\* Sales target achievement

\* Customer satisfaction

\* Staff attendance and productivity

\* Stock accuracy

\* Wastage and damage control

\* Cash accuracy

\* Outlet hygiene and presentation

\* Product availability

\* Compliance with company SOPs

\#\#\# Required Skills

\* Good communication and leadership skills

\* Customer\-service skills

\* Basic computer knowledge

\* Basic knowledge of sales, stock, and cash handling

\* Ability to manage staff and daily operations

\* Problem\-solving and decision\-making ability

\* Ability to work under pressure and during peak business hours

\#\#\# Qualification \& Experience

\* Minimum Degree preferred.

\* Previous experience in bakery, food \& beverage, retail, or outlet operations preferred.

\* Supervisory experience will be an added advantage.

title: Manager - MEFF Consulting (Vadodara/Gurugram/Chennai)
description:
**Job Description**  

As a Manager of the Marketing Effectiveness business unit at NIQ, you will be a key contributor to how top global FMCG (and other) companies optimize their media investments. You will manage the delivery of marketing effectiveness analytical solutions, with a strong focus on Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) \& Matched Market Tests (MMT). This role requires a blend of analytical expertise, solid client\-facing relationship skills, and the ability to coordinate internal and external resources to bring insights to life. Your recommendations will directly support and shape tactical media investments for leading global brands.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage Media Analytics Engagements: Execute and deliver Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) and other media effectiveness solutions to answer critical client business questions and help optimize their future media spend.
* Coordinate Cross\-Functional Delivery: Manage client engagements by synchronizing resources and timelines across global internal NIQ teams, media agencies, publishers, and clients to ensure smooth execution in a fast\-paced environment.
* Translate Data into Strategy: Transform complex statistical outputs into clear, compelling data stories. Explain methodologies to non\-technical stakeholders and deliver action\-oriented media recommendations.
* Build Client Partnerships: Serve as a trusted partner to client stakeholders (Managers, Directors), navigating business challenges, resolving day\-to\-day issues, and supporting the integration of our analytic solutions into their activation strategies.
* Support Team Excellence: Mentor and guide junior analysts and team members. Help optimize workflows, manage shifting priorities, and contribute to enhancing the Marketing Effectiveness team's capabilities through process improvements.
* Support Business Growth: Collaborate with senior leadership and the sales organization to demonstrate the value of our analytics, helping identify opportunities to expand client engagements.

 **Qualifications** **Experience \& Expertise**

* Industry \& Media Experience: 4 to 6 years of experience in Analytics, Consulting, Media, Market Research, or Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG).
* Media Analytics \& MMM: Strong hands\-on experience in media effectiveness analytics, with a clear focus on Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) and attribution frameworks.
* Client Partnerships: Solid relationship\-building skills with a proven track record of advising clients. Adept at navigating complex situations collaboratively and executing solutions that drive tangible business value.
* Delivery \& Orchestration: Demonstrated ability to manage multi\-faceted initiatives. Skilled at coordinating cross\-functional resources, managing priorities, and ensuring reliable execution across internal teams, agencies, and clients.
* Analytical Acumen: Applies rigorous logic, deductive reasoning, and critical thinking to translate data into actionable solutions for manufacturer marketing and CPG business challenges.
* Polished Data Storytelling: A capable communicator and presenter who bridges the gap between technical methodologies and strategic business narratives for non\-technical audiences.
* Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement: Strong team player dedicated to fostering a collaborative, high\-performing culture. Contributes to process improvements and supports team skill development with accountability.

**Education**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree required.
* Education\+: Advanced degree in an analytics\-focused, mathematical, or quantitative discipline is an asset.
* Technical Foundation: Solid foundational background in marketing research with working knowledge of statistical and data science methodologies, and how to apply them to real\-world business objectives.

 **Additional Information** **Our Benefits**

* Flexible working environment
* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning
* Employee\-Assistance\-Program (EAP)

The ideal candidate must have substantial hands\-on experience in **factory HR operations, Industrial Relations (IR), labour law compliance, union handling, contract labour management and workforce administration**.

This role requires a strong HR professional who understands the complexities of a manufacturing environment, can effectively manage workmen and staff, maintain harmonious industrial relations, and ensure smooth plant operations through effective people management and statutory compliance.

* Coordinate closely with Production, Stores, Maintenance, Finance, Security and other departments.

* Manage sourcing, screening, interviews, selection, salary negotiations and joining formalities.
* Ensure timely closure of critical vacancies and maintain an effective recruitment pipeline.

* Drive employee engagement, welfare activities and initiatives to improve workforce morale.
* Support supervisors and department heads in people management and performance\-related matters.
* Identify training needs and promote a culture of discipline, productivity and continuous improvement.

7\. Payroll, HR Administration \& MIS

* Oversee attendance, leave management, overtime calculations and payroll coordination.

* Manage onboarding, confirmation, transfers, promotions, separation, exit formalities and full \& final settlements.

The Field Recruiter will identify, attract and mobilise skilled, semi\-skilled and unskilled workers for SISCO’s manufacturing operations. The role involves building local recruitment networks, conducting recruitment drives and coordinating candidates through screening, trade tests and joining.

**Responsibilities include:**

* Understand manpower requirements, required trades, eligibility criteria and joining timelines in coordination with HR and department heads.
* Source welders, fitters, fabricators, machine operators, electricians, grinders, helpers and trainees through field visits and direct outreach.
* Build relationships with ITIs, polytechnics, skill development centres, placement officers and local employment networks.
* Conduct recruitment drives in nearby towns, villages and industrial areas, and participate in relevant job fairs.
* Develop employee referral networks and maintain a pool of candidates for recurring and urgent requirements.
* Screen candidates for relevant experience, qualifications, trade exposure, salary expectations and availability.
* Clearly explain the job, work location, shifts, wages, benefits and applicable accommodation or transport arrangements.
* Coordinate interviews and trade tests with the relevant departments and follow up with selected candidates until joining.
* Collect required candidate documents and coordinate verification and onboarding with HR.

* Maintain recruitment records and submit daily or weekly reports covering field visits, candidates sourced, interviews, selections, joinings and pending requirements.

**Requirements for the role:**

* Diploma or bachelor’s degree or Master's in any discipline; relevant field recruitment experience will be an advantage.
* Experience in recruiting workers for manufacturing, heavy engineering, fabrication or industrial staffing is preferred.
* Familiarity with shop\-floor trades and the ability to conduct basic suitability screening before technical assessment.
* Strong spoken Tamil and good interpersonal skills; Hindi proficiency is an advantage when recruiting workers from other states.
* Basic English reading and writing skills for maintaining records and reports.
* Willingness to travel regularly and independently organise field visits and recruitment drives.
* Good communication, persuasion, follow\-up and relationship\-building skills.
* Basic proficiency in MS Excel, smartphone\-based recruitment tools and candidate database management.

description:
Production Executive

**Location:** Coimbatore  
**Department:** Production  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Reports To:** Production Manager / Head of Production  
**Experience:** 2\+ Years

About the Role

We are looking for a **production executive** to support and manage day\-to\-day production operations, ensuring smooth manufacturing processes, optimum manpower utilization, timely production, quality compliance, and effective resource management.

The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in production planning, shop\-floor management, manpower coordination, material management, production documentation, and process improvement.

Key Responsibilities 1\. Production Planning \& Execution

* Plan and execute daily production activities based on production requirements and schedules.
* Coordinate with the production manager to achieve planned production volumes within the defined timelines.
* Monitor production activities throughout the shift and ensure smooth workflow.
* Allocate manpower and resources effectively based on production requirements.
* Ensure production is carried out according to approved processes, SOPs, and work instructions.
* Monitor production output and immediately report major deviations or delays to the reporting manager.

2\. Shop\-Floor Management

* Supervise day\-to\-day production activities on the shop floor.
* Ensure proper utilization of manpower, machines, materials, and other production resources.
* Monitor employee attendance, productivity, work allocation, and discipline within the production area.
* Ensure proper housekeeping and workplace organization in the production area.
* Identify operational issues and coordinate with the concerned teams for timely resolution.
* Maintain smooth coordination between shifts and ensure proper handover of pending activities.

3\. Manpower Management

* Allocate operators and workers according to production requirements.
* Monitor manpower availability and identify shortages that may affect production.
* Guide and support production staff in performing their assigned activities.
* Train employees on production procedures, SOPs, safety practices, and work instructions.
* Monitor employee performance and communicate recurring issues to the production manager.
* Ensure proper discipline and adherence to company policies within the production area.

4\. Raw Material \& Material Coordination

* Coordinate with stores and purchase teams to ensure timely availability of raw materials, packaging materials, and other production requirements.
* Verify material availability before starting production.
* Monitor material consumption against production requirements.
* Identify material shortages, excess consumption, wastage, or production\-related material issues.
* Ensure proper handling and storage of materials within the production area.
* Coordinate material movement between stores and Production.

5\. Production \& Quality Coordination

* Ensure production activities comply with defined quality standards and approved specifications.
* Coordinate with the Quality team for in\-process inspections and quality checks.
* Identify and report quality deviations during production.
* Support investigation of production\-related quality issues and implementation of corrective actions.
* Ensure rejected, damaged, or non\-conforming materials are properly identified and segregated.
* Follow approved SOPs and quality procedures during production activities.

6\. Machine \& Equipment Coordination

* Monitor the operational condition of production machinery and equipment.
* Coordinate with the maintenance team for machine breakdowns and technical issues.
* Report recurring machine problems that affect production efficiency.
* Ensure machines are operated safely and according to approved operating procedures.
* Support preventive maintenance activities by coordinating production requirements with the maintenance team.
* Ensure proper cleaning and basic upkeep of production equipment.

7\. Production Records \& Documentation

* Maintain accurate daily production records and reports.
* Record production quantity, rejection, wastage, downtime, manpower, and material consumption.
* Ensure proper completion of batch records, production sheets, checklists, and other required documents.
* Maintain shift\-wise production records and handover information.
* Ensure production documentation is complete, accurate, and available for review.
* Support preparation of daily, weekly, and monthly production reports.

8\. Production Reconciliation

* Reconcile planned production against actual production.
* Monitor raw material consumption against production output.
* Identify production variances, wastage, rejection, and process losses.
* Coordinate with Stores and Accounts/Finance teams wherever required for material and production reconciliation.
* Investigate significant variances and report findings to the production manager.

9\. Wastage \& Process Improvement

* Monitor production wastage and identify the reasons for excess wastage.
* Implement approved corrective actions to reduce material and process losses.
* Identify opportunities to improve production efficiency and reduce downtime.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives within the production process.
* Suggest practical improvements in workflow, manpower utilization, material handling, and production processes.

10\. Safety \& Compliance

* Ensure employees follow all applicable production safety procedures.
* Ensure appropriate use of PPE and other safety equipment.
* Report unsafe conditions, accidents, near misses, and safety concerns immediately.
* Maintain a safe and organized production environment.
* Ensure compliance with company SOPs, statutory requirements, and internal production policies.

11\. Cross\-Functional Coordination

* Coordinate with stores for raw material and packaging material requirements.
* Coordinate with Quality for inspections, testing, and quality\-related issues.
* Coordinate with Maintenance for machine breakdowns and preventive maintenance.
* Coordinate with Purchase for material availability and shortages.
* Coordinate with Planning/Sales for production requirements and schedules.
* Coordinate with HR regarding manpower availability, attendance, training, and disciplinary matters.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in **production, mechanical, industrial engineering, manufacturing, or a related field**.
* **2\+ years of experience** in production operations, manufacturing, or a similar role.
* Experience in handling production activities in a manufacturing environment.
* Practical knowledge of production planning and shop\-floor operations.
* Experience in manpower and material coordination.
* Good understanding of production processes, SOPs, quality requirements, and safety practices.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication and team\-handling skills.
* Willingness to work in a manufacturing/production environment.

Preferred Skills

* Production planning and scheduling
* Shop\-floor management
* Manpower handling
* Material planning and coordination
* Production documentation
* Batch record management
* Production reconciliation
* Wastage monitoring and control
* Quality coordination
* Machine and maintenance coordination
* Process improvement
* Inventory and material management
* Problem\-solving and decision\-making
* Team leadership

Software \& Technical Skills

* **MS Excel / Google Sheets**
* Production MIS and reporting
* ERP / Manufacturing Management Software
* Inventory Management Systems
* Basic knowledge of **SAP / ERP / MRP systems** – added advantage
* Knowledge of Excel functions, pivot tables, data analysis, and production reporting
* Knowledge of production planning and inventory modules – added advantage

Personal Attributes

* Strong ownership and accountability
* Good attention to detail
* Ability to work under production timelines
* Practical and solution\-oriented approach
* Strong coordination and communication skills
* Ability to handle shop\-floor challenges
* Team\-oriented and disciplined
* Willingness to learn and improve processes

Bluebenz Digitizations is a technology and digital transformation company specializing in ERP Solutions, Manufacturing Resource Planning (MRP), AI Engineering, Data Engineering, Product Engineering, Digital Transformation, Business Intelligence (BI), Robotic Process Automation (RPA), Cloud Solutions, and Custom Software Development.

We help manufacturing and industrial organizations improve operational efficiency, visibility, productivity, and business growth through innovative technology solutions.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a dynamic, ambitious, and result\-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive business growth by engaging directly with manufacturing companies, factories, industrial units, and corporate offices across Maharashtra.

The role involves identifying prospective clients, meeting key decision\-makers, understanding business challenges, presenting Bluebenz ERP and digital transformation solutions, arranging product demonstrations, and generating qualified business opportunities. The position requires extensive field travel across MIDCs and industrial clusters.

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. Lead Generation \& Prospecting

The candidate will actively visit industrial areas, MIDCs, factories, and manufacturing companies to identify new business opportunities. Responsibilities include generating leads through direct visits, networking, and referrals while maintaining a structured database of prospective clients.

The candidate will regularly interact with Managing Directors, Business Owners, Plant Heads, Factory Managers, Production Managers, Operations Heads, IT Managers, and Purchase Heads to introduce Bluebenz solutions and explore potential business opportunities.

2\. Business Development

The Field Sales Executive will promote Bluebenz ERP, MRP, Manufacturing Automation, AI, Business Intelligence, and Digital Transformation solutions to manufacturing organizations.

The role requires understanding customer challenges related to production planning, inventory management, process automation, reporting, and operational efficiency, and identifying opportunities for ERP implementation, manufacturing digitization, business intelligence, AI\-driven automation, and custom software development.

3\. Meetings \& Product Demonstrations

The candidate will schedule and conduct meetings with decision\-makers, present company solutions, and coordinate online or onsite product demonstrations with technical teams.

The role also includes participating in requirement\-gathering discussions and ensuring effective follow\-up with prospects to move opportunities through the sales cycle.

4\. Sales Pipeline Management

The candidate will maintain daily activity reports, update CRM records, track opportunities from lead generation to closure, and maintain an accurate sales pipeline.

Regular reporting, forecasting, and achievement of assigned business development targets will be a key part of the role.

5\. Relationship Building

Building long\-term relationships with industrial clients is critical to success in this position. The candidate will participate in industrial exhibitions, trade fairs, networking events, and industry association meetings to expand Bluebenz's market presence.

The role also involves developing referral networks and maintaining strong customer relationships that contribute to repeat business and future opportunities.

6\. Market Intelligence

The candidate will continuously monitor industry trends, competitor activities, and ERP adoption patterns within the manufacturing sector.

Insights gathered from customers and the market should be shared with management to support strategic business decisions and identify emerging opportunities.

**Performance Expectations**

The successful candidate is expected to maintain a strong field presence and consistently generate new business opportunities.

Expected activity levels include conducting approximately 8 to 12 factory visits per day, meeting 4 to 5 decision\-makers daily, adding at least 25 new prospects every week, maintaining a healthy sales pipeline, and contributing to monthly business opportunity generation targets.

**Educational Qualifications**

Applicants should possess a Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Computer Applications, Engineering, or a related field. An MBA in Marketing or Sales will be considered an added advantage.

**Experience Requirements**

Fresh graduates with strong communication skills, confidence, and a genuine interest in sales are encouraged to apply.

Candidates with 1 to 5 years of experience in ERP Sales, Software Sales, Industrial Sales, Manufacturing Solutions Sales, or B2B Sales will be preferred.

**Skills \& Competencies**

The ideal candidate should possess strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.

A basic understanding of ERP systems, manufacturing operations, inventory management, production planning, and business software solutions will be advantageous.

The candidate should be self\-motivated, target\-oriented, proactive, and capable of working independently in a field\-sales environment.

**Travel Requirements**

This position requires extensive travel across industrial regions including Pune MIDC, Chakan MIDC, Bhosari MIDC, Ranjangaon MIDC, Talegaon Industrial Area, Pimpri\-Chinchwad Industrial Belt, Satara, Kolhapur, Nashik, Aurangabad, Ahmednagar, and other industrial zones across Maharashtra.

Candidates must possess a two\-wheeler and should be comfortable with frequent local and regional travel.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

The compensation package will range from ₹XYZ to ₹ PQR per month depending on qualifications, experience, and performance.

In addition to fixed compensation, employees will be eligible for performance\-based incentives, travel allowance, fuel reimbursement, mobile allowance, performance bonuses, and career advancement opportunities.

**Regional Sales Manager**

**Sales Head**

**Why Join Bluebenz?**

Bluebenz offers an opportunity to work with leading manufacturing companies and contribute to their digital transformation journey. Employees gain exposure to ERP, AI, Automation, Business Intelligence, and Industrial Digitalization projects while enjoying a performance\-driven environment with significant career growth potential.

title: Executive Housekeeper
description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONEXECUTIVE HOUSEKEEPER

**Hotel:** Okean De Goa  
**Department:** Housekeeping  
**Position:** Executive Housekeeper  
**Reports To:** General Manager / Operations Manager  
**Supervises:** Housekeeping Supervisors, Room Attendants, Housepersons, Public Area Attendants, Linen/Laundry Staff and other Housekeeping Team Members  
**Location:** Goa  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

1\. JOB PURPOSE

The Executive Housekeeper is responsible for the overall management and smooth operation of the Housekeeping Department at Okean De Goa.

The position is responsible for maintaining high standards of **cleanliness, hygiene, presentation, guest comfort and room readiness** throughout the hotel. The Executive Housekeeper will lead the housekeeping team, plan daily operations, conduct inspections, control inventory and linen, coordinate with other departments, and ensure that guest rooms and public areas are maintained according to the hotel's standards.

2\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIESA. Housekeeping Operations

* Plan, organize and supervise the day\-to\-day operations of the Housekeeping Department.
* Ensure all guest rooms are cleaned, inspected and released on time for arrivals.
* Monitor departure rooms, stay\-over rooms, vacant rooms and priority rooms.
* Ensure corridors, lobby areas, public areas, staircases, back\-of\-house areas and other hotel premises are maintained properly.
* Prepare and implement daily cleaning schedules and deep\-cleaning schedules.
* Ensure housekeeping operations are properly managed during high\-occupancy periods.
* Coordinate room cleaning priorities according to arrivals, VIP guests, special requests and operational requirements.

B. Room Inspection \& Quality Control

* Conduct regular inspections of guest rooms and public areas.
* Ensure rooms meet Okean De Goa's required standards before releasing them to Front Office.
* Check cleanliness, linen, towels, amenities, bathroom condition, furniture, fixtures, lighting, AC condition and overall room presentation.
* Identify maintenance defects and immediately report them to the Maintenance/Engineering Department.
* Follow up on reported defects until they are resolved.
* Take corrective action whenever housekeeping standards are not maintained.
* Maintain consistent hygiene and cleanliness standards throughout the property.

C. Staff Management

* Supervise and manage the complete Housekeeping team.
* Prepare staff duty rosters, shifts, weekly offs and work allocations.
* Allocate rooms and cleaning duties according to occupancy and workload.
* Monitor staff attendance, grooming, discipline and performance.
* Conduct daily briefings and communicate operational priorities to the team.
* Train new employees on cleaning procedures, hotel standards, hygiene, safety and guest service.
* Conduct regular on\-the\-job training and refresher training.
* Motivate the team and maintain professional discipline within the department.
* Evaluate staff performance and recommend training or corrective action where required.

D. Front Office Coordination

* Maintain close coordination with the Front Office regarding room status.
* Ensure accurate and timely communication of **Vacant Clean, Vacant Dirty, Occupied, Out of Order and Out of Service** room status.
* Prioritize rooms according to expected arrivals and guest requirements.
* Coordinate early\-arrival rooms wherever operationally possible.
* Communicate room readiness to Front Office without unnecessary delay.
* Coordinate with Front Office regarding guest complaints, room changes, special requests and late check\-outs.

E. Linen \& Laundry Management

* Maintain proper control of bed sheets, pillow covers, towels, bath mats, blankets and other hotel linen.
* Maintain minimum and maximum/par stock levels.
* Conduct regular linen inventories and identify shortages or damages.
* Ensure proper handling, storage and movement of clean and soiled linen.
* Monitor laundry quality and turnaround time.
* Ensure damaged or condemned linen is properly recorded.
* Maintain proper records for linen movement and consumption.

F. Housekeeping Supplies \& Inventory

* Maintain adequate stock of cleaning chemicals, guest amenities, toiletries and housekeeping materials.
* Monitor daily consumption and avoid unnecessary wastage.
* Maintain proper housekeeping store records.
* Prepare purchase requisitions when stock reaches the required reorder level.
* Check the quality and quantity of supplies received.
* Ensure all chemicals and cleaning products are properly labelled, stored and handled safely.
* Maintain control over housekeeping equipment such as vacuum cleaners, mops, trolleys, cleaning machines and other tools.

G. Guest Service \& Complaints

* Ensure prompt response to guest requests related to housekeeping.
* Handle cleanliness\-related guest complaints professionally and ensure proper resolution.
* Coordinate room changes and additional cleaning requirements when necessary.
* Ensure VIP/special occasion rooms are prepared as per instructions.
* Maintain guest privacy and confidentiality at all times.
* Ensure Lost \& Found procedures are strictly followed and all items are recorded and handed over as per hotel policy.

H. Hygiene, Safety \& Security

* Ensure compliance with hotel hygiene and sanitation standards.
* Ensure safe handling and storage of cleaning chemicals.
* Ensure housekeeping staff use equipment and chemicals correctly.
* Maintain safe working practices to prevent accidents and injuries.
* Report unsafe conditions immediately to the concerned department.
* Ensure guest rooms and housekeeping areas are properly secured.
* Ensure master keys and room keys are handled strictly according to hotel policy.
* Ensure Lost \& Found items are handled and recorded properly.

I. Cost Control

* Monitor housekeeping departmental expenses.
* Control unnecessary consumption of chemicals, amenities, linen and other supplies.
* Minimize linen and inventory losses.
* Monitor staff productivity and manpower requirements according to occupancy.
* Reduce wastage without compromising cleanliness or guest satisfaction.
* Assist management in preparing the Housekeeping Department budget and operational requirements.

J. Coordination With Other Departments

Maintain effective coordination with:

* **Front Office** – Room status, arrivals, departures, room changes and guest requests.
* **Maintenance/Engineering** – Room defects, repairs and preventive maintenance.
* **F\&B Department** – Public area cleanliness and housekeeping requirements.
* **Security** – Lost \& Found, guest/property security and incidents.
* **HR** – Recruitment, attendance, training, discipline and employee matters.
* **Stores/Purchase** – Housekeeping supplies, chemicals, linen and equipment.
* **Management** – Daily operational issues, manpower, expenses and departmental performance.

3\. DAILY REPORTS \& RECORDS

The Executive Housekeeper shall ensure that the following records are properly maintained:

* Daily Housekeeping Report
* Room Status Report
* Room Inspection Checklist
* Housekeeping Duty Roster
* Staff Attendance Record
* Linen Inventory
* Laundry Record
* Housekeeping Stock/Inventory Record
* Cleaning Chemical Consumption Record
* Lost \& Found Register
* Maintenance/Defect Report
* Deep Cleaning Schedule
* Public Area Cleaning Schedule
* Guest Complaint/Request Record
* Purchase Requisition Records

4\. KEY PERFORMANCE AREAS (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Guest room cleanliness and presentation
* Timely room readiness
* Public area cleanliness
* Guest feedback and housekeeping complaints
* Staff productivity and discipline
* Linen control and inventory accuracy
* Housekeeping supply and chemical cost control
* Reduction of wastage and damages
* Timely reporting and resolution of maintenance issues
* Staff training and grooming standards
* Compliance with hotel hygiene and safety procedures
* Effective coordination with Front Office and other departments

Pay: ₹23,000\.96 \- ₹35,000\.58 per month

**About Telosa**

Telosa is an AI\-powered customer experience platform for multi\-location brands — reputation, listings, lead capture, AI resolution and marketing in one dashboard. We work with enterprise clients across India, MENA and Southeast Asia. Small team, fast decisions, direct exposure to how a company gets built.

**The role**

This is the founder's support role for everything that keeps the company running — people, office, compliance — plus the coordination behind client renewals and the quality of what leaves Telosa in writing. It suits someone early in their career who is organised, versatile, and wants range rather than a narrow lane. You will learn by sitting close to the founder and being the person things route through.

**What you'll do**

*Human Resources*

* Coordinate hiring: post roles, source through portals and consultants, do first\-level screening calls, schedule interviews, and follow up with candidates through offer and joining.
* Run onboarding — documentation, appointment letters, induction, asset handover, first\-week experience — and handle exits with the same care.
* Maintain employee records, attendance and leave data; prepare the monthly payroll input for the founder's review.
* Keep HR policy documents current and be the first point of contact for everyday employee queries.
* Organise team events, the festival and birthday calendar, and review scheduling.

*Administration \& Office*

* Run the Baner office day to day: facilities, housekeeping, IT assets, supplies, vendor coordination and AMC renewals.
* Track statutory and compliance paperwork, registrations, insurance and licence renewals; coordinate with the CA and external consultants.
* Process invoices, reimbursements and petty cash; support finance on collections follow\-up.
* Arrange travel, accommodation and visa paperwork for the team.

*Client Renewals — coordination*

* Maintain the master contract tracker: every client, value, renewal date and notice period, always current.
* Flag renewals 60–90 days ahead and pull together the account's usage and outcome data with the customer success and product teams, so the founder walks in prepared.
* Push renewal documentation through to signature and track receivables against it.
* Raise early warning signs — client gone quiet, delayed payment, dropped usage.

*External Communications*

* Draft and manage correspondence going out under the founder's name: client and partner follow\-ups, meeting notes, action trackers, investor update inputs.
* Manage the founder's calendar and prepare briefing notes ahead of external meetings.
* Own the shared inboxes and coordinate outbound comms with the marketing team.
* Keep decks, proposals and templates versioned and presentable.

**What we're looking for**

* 1\+ year of experience in HR, executive assistance, business operations, client servicing or a similar coordination role. Strong internship experience counts.
* High ownership. Chases things to closure without reminders, keeps confidences, and holds several unrelated threads in a day without dropping any.
* Genuinely strong written English. You will be drafting on behalf of the founder; the writing has to land without correction.
* Graduate in any discipline; an MBA/PGDM in HR is welcome but not required.
* Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets, PowerPoint and business email, and quick to pick up new tools.
* Presentable and composed with senior external stakeholders — clients, investors, partners, vendors.

**Nice to have**

* Exposure to payroll, statutory compliance or contract administration.
* Experience in a B2B SaaS, startup or agency environment.

**What you get**

* A direct line to the founder and visibility into every part of the business — hiring, clients, fundraising, operations. Rare at this stage of a career.
* Real ownership from month one, not a filing job.
* Compensation as per experience.

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Quality Control Assistant (QC Assistant)

**Department:** Quality Control  
**Designation:** Quality Control Assistant  
**Reporting To:** QC Officer / QC Executive / QC Manager  
**Industry:** Pharmaceutical / API Manufacturing  
**Experience:** 0–3 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Location:** turbhe

1\. Job Purpose

To support routine Quality Control activities including sampling, testing, documentation, laboratory housekeeping, and maintenance of laboratory records in accordance with **GMP, GLP, approved SOPs, specifications, and company quality standards**.

2\. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Laboratory Testing

* Assist in routine testing of **raw materials, intermediates, APIs, finished products, and other samples** as per approved specifications and SOPs.
* Perform basic chemical and physical analysis under the supervision of senior QC personnel.
* Prepare samples, reagents, solutions, and standards as required.
* Record test results accurately in laboratory worksheets, registers, and analytical records.
* Inform the senior QC personnel immediately of any abnormal or unexpected results.

B. Sampling

* Assist in sampling of raw materials, packing materials, intermediates, and finished products as per approved sampling procedures.
* Ensure proper labeling and identification of samples.
* Maintain sample traceability and transfer samples to the laboratory as per procedures.

C. Laboratory Documentation

* Maintain analytical worksheets, logbooks, registers, and other QC records.
* Follow **Good Documentation Practices (GDP)** while recording laboratory activities.
* Ensure all entries are accurate, legible, complete, and traceable.
* Maintain records of reagent and standard preparation, usage, and expiry.

D. Instruments \& Equipment

* Assist in operation of laboratory instruments under supervision.
* Ensure instruments are clean and properly maintained.
* Record equipment usage and maintain instrument logbooks.
* Inform senior personnel about equipment malfunction or abnormal performance.
* Support calibration and preventive maintenance activities.

E. Reagents \& Solutions

* Prepare laboratory reagents, volumetric solutions, buffers, and other solutions as per approved procedures.
* Properly label all prepared solutions with preparation date, expiry/retest date, and other required details.
* Maintain records of preparation and standardization where applicable.
* Ensure expired or unsuitable reagents are identified and disposed of according to procedures.

F. GMP / GLP Compliance

* Follow applicable **GMP, GLP, SOPs, safety requirements, and laboratory procedures**.
* Maintain cleanliness and housekeeping of the laboratory.
* Ensure proper handling, storage, and disposal of chemicals and laboratory waste.
* Report any deviation, abnormal observation, or safety concern to the supervisor.

G. Stability \& Retention Samples

* Assist in collection, labeling, storage, and retrieval of stability samples.
* Maintain stability sample records and storage conditions.
* Assist in management of retention samples as per approved procedures.

H. Audit \& Inspection Support

* Support preparation of laboratory documents and records for internal audits, customer audits, and regulatory inspections.
* Ensure laboratory records are readily available and properly maintained.
* Assist in addressing routine audit observations under the guidance of senior QC personnel.

3\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Accuracy and completeness of analytical records.
* Timely completion of assigned testing activities.
* Compliance with GMP/GLP and SOP requirements.
* Proper maintenance of laboratory records and logbooks.
* Correct preparation and labeling of reagents and solutions.
* Laboratory housekeeping and safety compliance.
* Proper handling and traceability of samples.

4\. Educational Qualification

**Essential:**

* B.Sc. / M.Sc. in **Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, or a related field**.

**Preferred:**

* B.Pharm / Diploma in Pharmacy or relevant laboratory qualification.
* Basic knowledge of analytical laboratory practices.

5\. Experience

* **0–3 years of relevant experience** in Quality Control / Analytical Laboratory in a pharmaceutical, API, chemical, or related manufacturing industry.
* Freshers with relevant educational qualifications may also be considered.

6\. Technical Knowledge

* Basic knowledge of pharmaceutical/API analysis.
* Understanding of laboratory safety practices.
* Basic knowledge of:
* pH meter
* Analytical balance
* UV\-Visible spectrophotometer
* HPLC/GC – basic exposure preferred
* Karl Fischer – basic exposure preferred
* Melting point / physical testing equipment
* Knowledge of GMP, GLP, GDP, and laboratory SOPs.

7\. Required Competencies

* Attention to detail
* Good laboratory practices
* Accuracy in documentation
* Basic analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Good communication skills
* Teamwork
* Time management
* Willingness to learn
* Safety\-conscious approach
* Quality\-focused mindset

8\. Reporting \& Coordination

**Reports To:** QC Officer / QC Executive / QC Manager

**Coordinates With:**  
Quality Assurance \| Production \| Warehouse \| R\&D \| Engineering \| EHS

9\. Overall Responsibility

The **Quality Control Assistant** is responsible for supporting laboratory testing, sampling, documentation, equipment handling, reagent preparation, and other QC activities while ensuring compliance with **GMP, GLP, approved SOPs, specifications, safety requirements, and company quality standards**.

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Reporting To:** HR \& Admin Manager / Hospital Administration

Job Purpose

We are looking for an experienced **Admin \& Electrical Engineer** who can independently manage the day\-to\-day administration, electrical systems, facility operations, vendors, security, housekeeping, inventory, fire \& safety compliance and overall building maintenance of a multi\-speciality hospital.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. Electrical \& Facility Management**

* Manage and monitor complete hospital electrical systems and electrical infrastructure.
* Handle DG Set, UPS, batteries, panels, wiring, lighting, earthing and other electrical equipment.
* Ensure preventive and breakdown maintenance of electrical systems.
* Coordinate with electricians and external technical agencies/vendors.
* Maintain electrical maintenance records, checklists and service schedules.
* Ensure uninterrupted power supply to critical hospital areas.

**2\. Building \& Infrastructure Management**

* Overall monitoring of hospital building, premises and infrastructure.
* Coordinate civil, plumbing, HVAC/AC, lift, water supply, drainage and other facility\-related maintenance.
* Identify maintenance requirements and arrange timely repairs.
* Maintain AMC/CMC records and preventive maintenance schedules.

**3\. Vendor Management**

* Identify and coordinate with maintenance/service vendors.
* Obtain quotations and coordinate comparative statements as required.
* Monitor vendor performance, service quality and timelines.
* Maintain vendor records, AMC agreements, work orders and service reports.
* Coordinate with vendors for electrical, fire, HVAC, lift, housekeeping, security, pest control and other facility services.

**4\. Security Management**

* Manage day\-to\-day security operations and security guards.
* Prepare/monitor security duty rosters and deployment.
* Ensure visitor, staff, vehicle and material movement protocols.
* Monitor CCTV, access control and other security systems.
* Conduct regular security rounds and report incidents to management.

**5\. Housekeeping Management**

* Supervise complete housekeeping operations of the hospital.
* Ensure cleanliness of OPD, IPD, OT, emergency, diagnostic areas, offices, washrooms and common areas.
* Monitor housekeeping manpower, duty rosters and attendance.
* Ensure availability and proper use of cleaning materials and consumables.
* Coordinate with housekeeping vendor/supervisor where applicable.

**6\. Inventory \& Stock Management**

* Manage administrative, housekeeping, electrical, maintenance and general stores.
* Maintain stock registers and issue/receipt records.
* Monitor minimum and maximum stock levels.
* Raise purchase requirements before stock\-out situations.
* Conduct periodic physical stock verification.
* Ensure proper storage, labeling and accountability of materials.

**7\. Fire \& Safety / Statutory Compliance**

* Maintain knowledge of hospital building\-related licences, permissions and statutory requirements.
* Coordinate for **Fire NOC, fire safety equipment, fire extinguishers, hydrant system, alarms, emergency exits and related compliance**.
* Ensure periodic inspection, testing and servicing of fire safety systems.
* Maintain fire safety records, checklists and certificates.
* Coordinate with relevant authorities/vendors for renewals and inspections.
* Ensure emergency exits and evacuation routes remain accessible.

**8\. Mock Drills \& Emergency Preparedness**

* Plan and coordinate periodic **Fire Mock Drills / Emergency Mock Drills**.
* Coordinate participation of security, housekeeping, nursing, admin and other departments.
* Maintain mock drill reports, observations and corrective action records.
* Ensure staff awareness regarding emergency evacuation and fire safety procedures.

**9\. Canteen \& Support Services**

* Coordinate day\-to\-day hospital canteen operations.
* Monitor hygiene, cleanliness, food quality and vendor/service standards.
* Coordinate canteen supplies, manpower and basic inventory.
* Ensure compliance with hospital's hygiene and safety requirements.

**10\. General Administration**

* Support overall hospital administration and facility operations.
* Coordinate with HR, Nursing, Medical, Pharmacy, Diagnostics and other departments for facility\-related requirements.
* Maintain daily facility reports and maintenance records.
* Handle administrative complaints and ensure timely resolution.
* Conduct regular rounds of the hospital premises and identify operational gaps.
* Prepare MIS/reports related to maintenance, security, housekeeping, inventory and facility operations.

Required Qualification

* Diploma / B.Tech / B.E. in **Electrical Engineering** preferred.
* Candidates with relevant Electrical/Facility Management experience may also be considered.
* Basic knowledge of hospital facility management and safety standards is preferred.

Required Experience

* **3–7 years of relevant experience** in Electrical, Facility, Engineering or Administration Management.
* Experience in a **hospital / healthcare facility / hotel / commercial building / large facility** will be preferred.

Key Skills

* Strong electrical \& technical knowledge
* Hospital/facility management
* Vendor \& AMC management
* Security \& housekeeping management
* Inventory \& stock management
* Fire safety \& emergency preparedness
* Mock drill coordination
* Building maintenance
* Preventive maintenance
* Basic statutory/licence compliance knowledge
* Team handling and manpower management
* MS Excel, Word and basic MIS reporting
* Good communication and coordination skills

Preferred Candidate Profile

The candidate should be capable of **independently monitoring the complete hospital facility and building operations**, coordinating multiple vendors and support departments, identifying technical/maintenance issues and ensuring timely resolution while maintaining safety, compliance and service standards.

**Important:** Candidate must be willing to take ownership of overall facility operations and coordinate with management for smooth, safe and uninterrupted hospital functioning.

Job Description – Financial Analyst (Finance \& Operations)

Role Summary

We are looking for a highly motivated Financial Analyst to join our finance team. The candidate should possess a minimum of one year of relevant experience and demonstrate strong attention to detail. In this capacity, the candidate will support budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, and reporting activities, thereby contributing to critical business decisions. This role offers significant opportunities for professional development and exposure to a broad spectrum of financial operations.

Key Responsibilities

i. Financial Reporting and Analysis

· Creating regular financial reports that include income statements, profit and loss accounts, balance sheets, cash flow statements etc for the client as well as management.

· Adherence to the tasks scheduled in the Cadence Report.

· Timely delivery of deliverables within cost to the client's satisfaction.

· Preparing and maintaining accurate accounting records, ensuring all financial transactions are properly documented and recorded.

ii. Cost Analysis \& Expense Management

· Identify opportunities to reduce costs within ongoing or future projects.

· Assist in forecasting project expenditures to support financial planning.

· Analyze variances between planned and actual costs and report findings.

· Prepare cost reports and dashboards for management review.

· Implement cost control measures and recommend corrective actions where necessary.

iii. Market \& Industry Research

· Monitoring real estate market trends, including rental rates, property prices, occupancy rates, and economic factors affecting the industry.

· Analyzing competitors’ rental pricing strategies, market positioning, and performance to recommend pricing adjustments or strategic decisions.

· Analyse customer preferences and demand patterns to support strategic planning.

· Track regulatory and policy changes impacting property management, leasing, and development.

iv. Report to Stakeholders

· Communicating with investors and stakeholders by providing detailed reports on financial performance, key metrics, and updates on property projects.

· Presenting financial insights and recommendations to senior management for strategic decision\-making.

· Using financial modeling tools, spreadsheets, or software (e.g., Excel, ERP systems) to analyze financial data and track performance.

· Streamlining reporting processes through the use of automation tools to reduce manual work and increase accuracy.

· Maintain accurate financial and operational records in accordance with company and project policies.

· Assist with document preparation and filing, ensuring everything is organized and easily accessible

vi. Compliance and Risk Management

· Ensure compliance with financial regulations, company policies, client requirements and industry standards.

· Help identify and assess financial and operational risks to be faced by the company or project, suggesting mitigation strategies.

vii. Collaboration and Communication

· Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, ensuring smooth communication between finance, operations, and other departments.

· Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

· Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Word techniques.

· Basic understanding of accounting principles, financial statements, and reporting.

· Attention to detail and the ability to work with large sets of data.

· Ability to work independently as well as part of a team in a fast\-paced environment.

description:
**Company Description**

DURGAM SOFT PVT. LTD. is a technology\-focused software product company based in Hyderabad, specializing in building modern, scalable, and user\-friendly software solutions for businesses. The company develops and continuously improves its own SaaS product, billmaster, while also working on modern web, mobile, and business technology solutions. Our development team follows modern engineering practices and focuses on clean code, practical problem\-solving, continuous learning, and the effective use of AI\-assisted development tools. We provide a professional environment where freshers can gain hands\-on experience by working on real\-world software products and modern technology stacks.

**Role Description**

This is a full\-time, on\-site Full Stack Developer – Fresher role located in Cherlapally, Hyderabad, Telangana. The Full Stack Developer will work with the software development team to design, develop, test, debug, and maintain modern web and mobile applications. The role involves working across front\-end, back\-end, database, API integration, and application development tasks.

The candidate will primarily work with React.js, Next.js, and React Native, along with MySQL and NoSQL databases, REST APIs, Git, and Figma. The role also involves using modern AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code to improve coding productivity, debugging, learning, documentation, and development workflows.

The candidate will be expected to understand AI\-generated code, verify its correctness, identify potential issues, make necessary improvements, and integrate the code appropriately rather than relying on AI tools without understanding the underlying concepts. The developer will collaborate with senior team members, designers, and other stakeholders to implement new features, fix bugs, improve application performance, and contribute to the continuous development of the company's software products.

**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in programming, software development, and problem\-solving, with a willingness to learn full\-stack application development.
* Basic to good knowledge of JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3, with an understanding of responsive web development.

* Good communication, teamwork, and time\-management skills.
* Ability to work effectively in an on\-site, collaborative software development environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, MCA, BCA, or a related field, or equivalent practical knowledge.
* Fresh graduates and candidates with 0–1 year of experience are welcome to apply.
* Academic projects, personal projects, GitHub repositories, internships, or a portfolio demonstrating practical development skills will be an advantage.

**Preferred / Additional Skills**

* TypeScript
* Node.js
* Express.js
* Firebase
* GitHub
* Basic knowledge of SEO and SEO\-friendly web development
* Basic understanding of cloud hosting and application deployment
* Familiarity with automated testing and debugging tools
* Experience using AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar tools
* Ability to independently learn new frameworks, libraries, and development technologies

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain responsive web applications using React.js and Next.js.
* Develop and maintain cross\-platform mobile applications using React Native.
* Build and integrate REST APIs with frontend and mobile applications.
* Work with MySQL and NoSQL databases for data storage and retrieval.
* Convert Figma UI/UX designs into functional and responsive interfaces.
* Write clean, reusable, and maintainable code following development standards.
* Use Git for source\-code management and collaborate with the development team through a structured version\-control workflow.
* Debug application issues, identify root causes, and implement appropriate solutions.
* Test applications and features to ensure reliability, usability, and performance.
* Optimize applications for performance and responsive behavior across different devices and screen sizes.
* Assist in implementing SEO\-friendly web applications where applicable.
* Use Claude Code and other AI\-assisted development tools to improve development productivity and problem\-solving.
* Review and validate AI\-generated code before using it in production applications.

* Work with senior developers and team members to understand requirements and implement features.
* Learn new technologies and development practices based on project requirements.
* Contribute to the development and improvement of the company's SaaS products and software applications.

**What We Look For**

We are looking for a motivated fresher who is genuinely interested in software development and wants to build a career as a full\-stack developer. The ideal candidate should have a strong foundation in programming, curiosity to learn new technologies, and the ability to solve problems logically.

Candidates do not need to be experts in every technology listed above. However, they should have a basic understanding of the core concepts and demonstrate the ability and willingness to learn and work across web, mobile, backend, databases, Git, UI implementation, and AI\-assisted development.

A strong learning attitude, logical thinking, ownership, discipline, and willingness to work on real\-world software products are highly valued.

description:
CRM / Partner Relationship Executive

**Industry:** Mutual Funds, Insurance \& Financial Services  
**Department:** Partner / Sub\-Broker Support  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive and responsible **CRM / Partner Relationship Executive** who will act as the **single point of contact for our Sub\-Brokers, Advisors and Business Partners**.

The primary responsibility of this role is to ensure that every partner receives timely support, regular updates and smooth coordination for their Mutual Fund, Insurance and other financial services business.

This is not merely a back\-office position. We are looking for someone who takes **complete ownership of partner queries from initiation to final resolution**.

Key Responsibilities

* Act as the dedicated point of contact for assigned Sub\-Brokers / Business Partners.
* Handle partner queries through calls, WhatsApp and email in a professional manner.
* Coordinate Mutual Fund transactions including SIP, Lumpsum, Redemption, Switch, STP, SWP, KYC, Mandates and related servicing requests.
* Coordinate Insurance proposals, renewals, policy servicing and other partner requirements with the concerned team.
* Follow up with partners for pending documents and information.
* Coordinate with internal Mutual Fund, Insurance, Claims and Operations teams for timely completion of requests.
* Maintain a proper tracker of all open, pending and completed cases.
* Provide **proactive status updates** to partners without waiting for them to follow up.
* Ensure queries and service requests are resolved within defined turnaround times.
* Escalate delayed or complicated cases to the appropriate senior team member.
* Assist partners with statements, reports, transaction status and other client\-servicing requirements.
* Follow up on renewals, pending opportunities and incomplete transactions.
* Maintain complete records of partner interactions and service requests in the CRM/software.
* Build strong long\-term relationships with assigned partners and ensure a high standard of service.

What We Are Looking For

* Strong communication skills in **Hindi and English**.
* Excellent follow\-up and coordination skills.
* Strong sense of **ownership and accountability**.
* Comfortable communicating with partners over phone, WhatsApp and email.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel, Google Sheets and basic computer applications.
* Ability to handle multiple cases simultaneously and prioritize urgent matters.
* Patient, professional and solution\-oriented attitude.
* Ability to work effectively with different internal departments.

Preferred Experience

Candidates with experience in any of the following will be preferred:

* Mutual Fund Distribution
* Wealth Management
* Banking / NBFC
* Insurance
* Stock Broking
* Financial Services
* Customer Relationship Management
* Customer Success / Client Servicing

**Freshers with excellent communication, learning ability and ownership skills may also apply.**

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will primarily be measured on:

* Turnaround time for partner requests
* Number and ageing of pending cases
* Timely partner updates
* Query\-resolution rate
* Partner satisfaction
* Accuracy of CRM records
* Renewal and business follow\-ups
* Internal coordination and case closure

Our Service Standard

**No partner should have to repeatedly follow up with us for an update.**

Every query should have a clear owner, current status, next action and expected resolution timeline.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who does not simply say:

**“I have forwarded your query to the concerned department.”**

We want someone who says:

**“I have taken up your case, coordinated with the concerned team, and I will update you until it is completely resolved.”**

If you believe in taking ownership, building relationships and delivering excellent service, we would like to hear from you.

About the Company

We are a leading hygiene products manufacturer in India, offering **plant\-based, eco\-conscious solutions across personal care categories**. Our products are developed in certified facilities and recognized through multiple national and state awards.

With a growing team of **55\+ employees**, we foster a supportive, ethical, and performance\-driven work culture. We value innovation, quality, and collaboration, providing a positive work environment where individuals can learn, contribute, and grow with a purpose\-led brand.

About the Internship

We are looking for a **creative and enthusiastic social media intern** to support our digital marketing and social media activities.

The intern will work closely with the marketing and social media teams to create engaging content, manage social media activities, monitor trends, support campaigns, and contribute to increasing brand visibility and audience engagement.

This is a hands\-on opportunity for someone interested in **social media management, content creation, digital marketing, branding, and consumer engagement**.

Key Responsibilities 1\. Social Media Management

* Assist in managing the company's social media platforms.
* Support regular posting of content across platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other relevant channels.
* Maintain the social media content calendar.
* Schedule posts according to the approved content plan.
* Ensure posts are published on time and follow brand guidelines.
* Monitor basic engagement and audience responses.

2\. Content Creation

* Assist in creating engaging social media content based on company products, campaigns, and brand communication.
* Develop ideas for reels, posts, stories, carousels, videos, and other social media formats.
* Support the creation of product\-focused and educational content.
* Research content ideas relevant to the hygiene, personal care, wellness, sustainability, and consumer\-product categories.
* Repurpose existing content into different social media formats.

3\. Reels \& Short\-Form Video

* Assist in developing ideas and scripts for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other short\-form videos.
* Support basic shooting and editing of social media videos.
* Identify trending video formats, sounds, topics, and content styles.
* Adapt relevant trends to suit the company's brand and products.
* Coordinate with the video editor/creative team for content production.

4\. Trend \& Competitor Research

* Regularly monitor social media trends and emerging content formats.
* Research competitor social media activities and content strategies.
* Track trending topics, hashtags, formats, and audience engagement patterns.
* Identify content opportunities that are relevant to the company's target audience.
* Share useful content ideas and observations with the social media manager.

5\. Community Engagement

* Monitor comments, messages, mentions, and audience interactions.
* Assist in responding to basic comments and queries according to company guidelines.
* Escalate customer complaints or sensitive queries to the appropriate team.
* Encourage meaningful audience engagement through appropriate responses and content.
* Maintain a professional and positive brand voice across social media platforms.

6\. Campaign Support

* Assist in planning and executing social media campaigns.
* Support promotional campaigns, product launches, festivals, awareness campaigns, and special occasions.
* Coordinate with the design, video, marketing, influencer, and other teams for campaign execution.
* Help prepare campaign content and posting schedules.
* Track campaign activities and maintain relevant records.

7\. Influencer \& Collaboration Support

* Assist in identifying relevant influencers and content creators.
* Research influencers based on category, audience, engagement, and content relevance.
* Maintain influencer databases and collaboration records.
* Support communication and coordination with influencers when required.
* Track content deliverables and posting status.

8\. Social Media Analytics \& Reporting

* Monitor basic social media performance metrics.
* Track reach, impressions, engagement, views, followers, clicks, and other relevant metrics.
* Prepare weekly and monthly social media performance reports.
* Identify high\-performing and low\-performing content.
* Support the team in identifying areas for content improvement.

9\. Content Calendar \& Documentation

* Maintain an updated social media content calendar.
* Track content status from idea to approval, design, publishing, and reporting.
* Maintain records of published posts, captions, creatives, videos, and campaign materials.
* Ensure required content is available before scheduled publishing dates.

10\. Cross\-Functional Coordination

* Coordinate with Marketing, Design, Video, Product Development, Sales, and other teams for content requirements.
* Collect product information required for social media content.
* Ensure product information and communication are accurate before publishing.
* Support the team during product launches and marketing activities.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree or pursuing a degree in **marketing, digital marketing, mass communication, media, journalism, business administration, or a related field**.
* Freshers and candidates with internship/project experience may apply.
* Strong interest in social media and digital marketing.
* Good understanding of major social media platforms.
* Good communication and writing skills.
* Basic understanding of social media trends and content formats.
* Creative thinking and willingness to experiment with new content ideas.

Preferred Skills

* Social media management
* Content creation
* Instagram and Facebook management
* LinkedIn content
* Reels and short\-form video content
* Caption writing
* Hashtag research
* Competitor research
* Trend analysis
* Community management

* Basic digital marketing knowledge
* Content calendar management

Software \& Tools

* Canva

* Adobe Photoshop – added advantage

* Meta Business Suite

Personal Attributes

* Creative and curious mindset

* Good communication skills
* Good writing ability
* Willingness to learn
* Attention to detail
* Ability to identify trends
* Proactive approach
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment

Learning Opportunities

* Social media management

* Brand communication
* Influencer collaborations
* Competitor and trend research

* Supportive and collaborative work environment

Apply Now

1\. Job Purpose

To support day\-to\-day laboratory activities, testing, sample preparation, equipment handling, documentation, and maintenance of laboratory standards while ensuring that all activities are carried out safely and as per defined procedures.

2\. Key Responsibilities

* Collect, receive, label, and maintain samples received from Production, Quality, R\&D, and other departments.
* Assist in preparation of samples for laboratory testing and analysis.
* Conduct routine laboratory tests as per approved SOPs and test methods.
* Operate laboratory equipment and instruments after receiving proper training.
* Record test results accurately in laboratory registers, formats, or approved software.
* Maintain proper identification and traceability of samples.
* Assist Lab In\-Charge/Quality/R\&D team in testing of raw materials, in\-process materials, finished products, and development samples.
* Maintain laboratory equipment, glassware, tools, and work areas in clean and usable condition.
* Support calibration and preventive maintenance activities of laboratory instruments.
* Inform the concerned person immediately in case of abnormal test results, equipment malfunction, sample damage, or safety concerns.
* Maintain laboratory chemicals, consumables, and other materials as per defined requirements.
* Ensure proper storage, identification, and handling of chemicals and laboratory materials.
* Follow laboratory safety procedures, PPE requirements, chemical handling procedures, and emergency protocols.
* Assist in preparation and maintenance of laboratory records, checklists, logbooks, and reports.
* Support internal/external audits and provide required laboratory records.
* Ensure proper disposal of laboratory waste as per company/environmental procedures.
* Maintain housekeeping and 5S standards within the laboratory.
* Perform any other laboratory\-related duties assigned by the reporting manager.

3\. Quality \& Compliance Responsibilities

* Follow approved SOPs, Work Instructions, and test methods.
* Ensure accuracy and integrity of laboratory data and records.
* Do not alter or manipulate test results.
* Maintain confidentiality of test results, product information, and R\&D\-related information.
* Follow applicable Quality, EHS, ISO, and company requirements.
* Immediately report any non\-conformance or deviation to the concerned authority.

4\. Safety Responsibilities

* Always use required PPE while working in the laboratory.
* Handle chemicals, samples, and laboratory equipment safely.
* Follow chemical labeling and storage requirements.
* Maintain awareness of emergency exits, fire extinguishers, first\-aid facilities, and emergency procedures.
* Report unsafe conditions, spills, incidents, and near misses immediately.
* Participate in safety training, mock drills, and other EHS activities.

5\. Required Skills

* Basic knowledge of laboratory practices and testing procedures.
* Basic understanding of measurements and calculations.
* Ability to maintain accurate records and documentation.
* Basic computer knowledge, especially MS Excel and MS Word.
* Good observation and attention to detail.
* Ability to follow SOPs and instructions.
* Basic understanding of laboratory safety and chemical handling.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Willingness to learn new testing methods and equipment.

6\. Educational Qualification

**Preferred:** ITI / Diploma / B.Sc. in Chemistry, Physics, Chemical, Mechanical, or a relevant technical/science discipline.

**Experience:**

* Freshers may be considered.

* Accuracy in Documentation
* Teamwork
* Learning Agility
* Problem Identification
* Time Management

* Process Compliance

* Proper sample identification and traceability.
* Accuracy and completeness of laboratory records.
* Compliance with SOPs and safety requirements.
* Proper maintenance of laboratory equipment and workplace.
* Timely reporting of abnormal test results/deviations.

* Analytical thinking
* Logical thinking
* Reasoning ability
* Problem\-solving skills
* Debugging skills
* Root\-cause analysis
* Attention to detail
* Ability to understand complex requirements

* Learning unfamiliar technologies

* Application security basics

* Unit and integration testing
* CI/CD basics
* Cloud and deployment fundamentals
* Performance and scalability fundamentals

What Makes a Strong Candidate

* Can take an idea and turn it into a working application.
* Learn new technologies quickly.
* Are comfortable working with unfamiliar frameworks or codebases.
* Have strong curiosity and continuously experiment with new technologies.
* Can use AI to significantly improve development speed without compromising quality.
