title: DevOps Engineer II
description:
**About Neo** 




  





 AI is the most significant shift in how work gets done since the advent of the Internet — yet most organizations fail to capture its value.
 **Neo** 
 is changing that.
 



 Founded by
 **Bhavin Turakhia**
 — Co\-Founder of
 
 Zeta
 
 ,
 
 Radix
 
 , and
 
 Titan
 
 —
 **Neo** 
 is building an integrated, AI\-first suite of products that capture work, centralize context, and make AI a first\-class participant in every workflow:
 


* **Tasket** 
 — A radically reimagined, AI\-native, work management platform that centralizes context and makes AI delegation seamless for all work.
* **Friday** 
 — AI Assistant, co\-worker and agent platform, pre\-integrated into Tasket, Studio, Drive and 1000\+ SaaS platforms.
* **Studio** 
 — AI\-native suite for co\-creating docs, spreadsheets and diagrams collaboratively with humans and agents.
* **Drive** 
 — AI\-native repository, where humans and agents can co\-work on files.
* **Scribe** 
 — AI assistant for meetings that goes beyond note\-taking and actually does your work while on the call.



  





**About the Role** 




 As a DevOps Engineer, you will build and operate the infrastructure and delivery platform behind the Neo suite — cloud, CI/CD, Kubernetes, and the path to production — working closely with senior engineers who set the architecture and standards.
 



 We are proponents of leveraging best\-in\-breed AI tools at every step of the engineering lifecycle — design, development, review, and testing. This requires a different engineering mindset: a lean team of hands\-on, AI\-adept engineers, resulting in ultra\-rapid iteration cycles and fast output. You will apply this approach every day, using agents to move faster while owning the quality of what ships.
 



 At Neo, the platform serves both people and a growing fleet of agents shipping change in parallel. This role is for an engineer with strong fundamentals who wants real production ownership and a steep learning curve.
 



  





**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**Cloud \& infrastructure** 



* Build, operate, and maintain cloud infrastructure on AWS/GCP/Azure, following the architecture and security standards set by the team.
* Write and maintain infrastructure as code with Terraform; contribute to reusable modules and keep an eye on cost and performance.



**Delivery \& GitOps** 



* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines as code; improve build speed, reliability, and quality checks on the path to production.
* Operate GitOps\-based deployments with Argo CD / Flux, and run rolling, canary, and blue\-green releases.



**Containers \& Kubernetes** 



* Deploy, run, and troubleshoot workloads on production Kubernetes — manifests and Helm charts, ingress (NGINX/Kong), autoscaling, and resource tuning.



**AI\-first delivery** 



* Use agentic tooling day to day to write, review, and test infrastructure code and automation — and validate what agents produce before it ships.
* Contribute to the guardrails and CI quality gates (linting, policy checks, plan reviews, scanning) that let engineers and agents ship safely.



**Reliability \& observability** 



* Set up and maintain dashboards, alerts, logs, and traces for the services you support.
* Participate in on\-call; triage and resolve incidents, and contribute to root\-cause analysis and follow\-up fixes.



**Security \& automation** 



* Apply cloud security best practices — least\-privilege IAM, secrets management, and image and dependency scanning.
* Write scripts and small tools in Python, Go, or Bash to automate repetitive operational work; document runbooks and share what you learn.



  





**Skills** 



* **AI\-native engineering practice** 
 — Uses agentic tooling across the lifecycle and builds the reusable modules, automation, and CI quality gates that make both human and agent\-authored infrastructure change safe to ship.
* **Systems \& networking** 
 — Solid Linux fundamentals (processes, filesystems, permissions, systemd, logs) and networking basics (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/TLS, load balancing, subnets and routing); comfortable debugging from the command line.
* **Cloud** 
 — Hands\-on with at least one major cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure): compute, VPC networking, IAM, storage, and managed databases.
* **Containers \& Kubernetes** 
 — Docker and image builds; hands\-on with Kubernetes objects (Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps/Secrets, HPA) and Helm or Kustomize.
* **CI/CD \& GitOps** 
 — Has built or maintained pipelines in tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins; working exposure to Argo CD or Flux.
* **Infrastructure as Code** 
 — Terraform (modules, remote state, plan/apply workflows); Ansible a plus.
* **Observability** 
 — Working knowledge of metrics, logging, and tracing tools (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki, OpenTelemetry); can use them to debug a live issue.
* **Security basics** 
 — IAM, secrets management (e.g. Vault or cloud secret managers), and secure CI/CD practices.
* **On\-call \& Incident Response** 
 — Experience in an on\-call rotation or hands\-on incident response.
* **Programming \& automation** 
 — Writes clean, reviewable Python, Go, or Bash for automation and tooling.



  





**Experience \& Qualifications** 



* 2\+ years of relevant experience in DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, or related roles.
* Software engineers with a bent towards Operations engineering or vice versa.
* Solid fundamentals in Linux/OS internals, networking, and system performance.
* Hands\-on experience with public or private cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure, or similar).
* Good understanding of distributed systems and microservices architectures.
* Proven experience with modern CI/CD practices, GitOps workflows, and deployment strategies.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and configuration management using Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools.
* Programming or scripting proficiency in Python, Go, or Bash.
* Has been part of a production on\-call rotation and has participated in incident response.
* Continuous learner with a strong ownership mindset and effective engineering practices.
* B.Tech / M.Tech in Computer Science or equivalent.



  





**Equal Opportunity** 




 Neo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds, cultures, and communities to apply and believe that a diverse workforce is key to our success.

title: Security Engineer
description:
* **24x7 Monitoring Systems and Networks:** 
  SOC Analysts continuously monitor networks and systems for suspicious activities or anomalies that could indicate a security breach. This involves analyzing logs, alerts, and other data to identify potential threats.
* **Incident Detection:** 
  Upon identifying a threat, SOC Analysts must quickly evaluate its severity. They use various tools, such as Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) systems, to correlate and analyze security data.
* **Investigation and Analysis:** 
  When a potential security incident is detected, SOC Analysts are responsible for conducting thorough investigations. They analyze the incident’s details, such as the attack vector, targeted systems, and possible impact, to determine the necessary response.
* **Incident Response:** 
  SOC Analysts are not just observers; they actively participate in incident response efforts. This includes containing and remediating security incidents to minimize damage and restore normal operations.
* Threat Analysis, Threat Intelligence
* Knowledge on Threat Hunting will be added advanctage



**Importance of SOC Analysts** 




 The significance of SOC Analysts extends beyond their daily responsibilities. They are essential for creating a security\-conscious culture within organizations. By establishing protocols and best practices, SOC Analysts help prevent potential attacks. Their proactive approach is crucial in safeguarding sensitive data and maintaining the integrity of IT systems.
 


* **Vulnerability Assessment (VA):** 
	+ Conduct regular vulnerability assessments to identify security weaknesses in applications and systems.
	+ Analyze and prioritize vulnerabilities based on risk and impact.
	+ Collaborate with development and operations teams to remediate identified vulnerabilities.
* **Penetration Testing (PT):** 
	+ Perform penetration testing on applications, networks, and systems to identify security gaps.
	+ Develop and execute test plans, document findings, and provide actionable recommendations.

description:
**Summary:** 




 This role is the primary point of contact for IT support within the organization, helping employees resolve laptop issues, account access problems, software installations, and everyday technical queries. It is an ideal opportunity to build a strong IT foundation while being guided and mentored by an experienced senior team.
 



  





**Position Overview:** 




 The “System Administrator” is responsible for maintaining smooth day\-to\-day IT operations across the organization. This role covers end\-user support, asset management, system upkeep, and vendor coordination, making it a well\-rounded position for someone looking to grow within an IT support function.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Provide day\-to\-day support to employees on tickets, laptops, logins, printers, software installations, and related requests.
* Complete daily preventive checks across the office — verifying that IT hardware, servers, UPS, and internet links are up, both physically and logically — and act on any deviation.
* Build and deliver new laptops end to end: imaging, domain join, host ID and AD account creation, project\-specific software, endpoint agent installation, asset tagging, and user handover.
* Maintain the asset register and host ID records accurately, and provision test PCs and virtual machines against validated user requirements, tracking usage duration and reclaiming resources on expiry.
* Manage the user account lifecycle — email IDs, AD accounts, distribution lists and group memberships, password resets, and access provisioning and revocation during onboarding and exit.
* Test and deploy Windows and third\-party patches through the endpoint management console, monitor patch non\-compliance reports, and resolve the root cause of failures.
* Maintain endpoint security compliance: monitor antivirus and endpoint protection consoles, bring non\-compliant systems back into compliance, respond to threat and data\-loss\-prevention alerts, and validate license terms for software approval requests.
* Run scheduled backups of servers, Active Directory, and databases to the NAS, and perform periodic restore checks with project teams to confirm data integrity.
* Coordinate with vendors for hardware, software, and facility requirements — obtaining and comparing quotes, securing approvals, releasing purchase orders, and following up until delivery and installation.
* Support network and infrastructure monitoring, including Wi\-Fi and LAN authentication, firewall and CCTV checks, and report anomalies to the senior team.
* Keep trackers, checklists, and basic documentation current to support ISO audits, knowledge sharing, and team organisation.
* Escalate recurring or complex issues to the Team Lead or Senior System Administrator for permanent resolution.

* Diploma, BCA, B.Sc., or B.E. (Postgraduate candidates will not be considered.)

title: Software Engineer, Products & Solutions
description:
ABV \| Bengaluru \| Full\-time, in person
   

  

 About ABV
   

  

 ABV works across investing, business building and technology\-led execution. We strengthen products, modernise systems and improve operations to drive growth.
   

  

 Our work spans commercial opportunities and government and enterprise needs, combining research, operational improvement and hands\-on implementation. This scope also includes improving and scaling technology businesses following acquisition: strengthening products, integrating systems and building the operational foundations for growth.
   

  

 About the role
   

  

 We’re hiring a Software Engineer, Products \& Solutions to build and deliver the technology behind these initiatives.
   

  

 You’ll translate business requirements into working software, make practical technical decisions and take clearly scoped projects or components through development, testing, deployment and ongoing improvement. The role combines product thinking with hands\-on engineering and responsibility for delivery.
   

  

 The scope includes enterprise applications, AI\-assisted workspaces, automation and software supporting public\-sector and utility operations. Some projects will involve building new products; others will require integrating systems and delivering against client requirements.
   

  

 We believe the right engineers, equipped with strong AI fluency and sound judgment, can become 10x builders. We’re looking for people who turn that potential into working software: using AI to learn unfamiliar systems, test ideas, automate repetitive work and ship faster without compromising quality. You don’t need years of experience to demonstrate this, but you do need to show what you have built. AI will be central to how you work, even when the product itself is not an AI application.
   

  

 Responsibilities
   

  

 • Turn business and user requirements into implementation plans, technical choices and clear delivery milestones.
   

 • Build applications, interfaces, backend services, databases, APIs and integrations.
   

 • Write maintainable code, use version control and document important design decisions.
   

 • Choose and combine AI coding tools, models and agents to research, implement, test and debug software. Review their output and take responsibility for the result.
   

 • Write automated tests, investigate failures and check edge cases before release.
   

 • Deploy and monitor software, troubleshoot production issues and improve reliability, performance and running costs.
   

 • Work with clients, users, vendors and domain specialists to clarify requirements, resolve blockers and support acceptance testing.
   

 • Build security, appropriate access controls, data validation and auditability into the systems you deliver.
   

 • Contribute to post\-acquisition improvement projects by modernising software, integrating systems and automating workflows to support business growth.
   

 • Communicate progress, risks and technical trade\-offs clearly.
   

  

 Minimum qualifications
   

  

 • Ability to write and debug code in at least one general\-purpose programming language, such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Go or C\+\+.
   

 • Understanding of core programming concepts, common data structures and basic algorithmic efficiency.
   

 • Practical experience building a software project using APIs, persistent data storage or a user interface.
   

 • Familiarity with Git and the fundamentals of testing and debugging.
   

 • Ability to break an unfamiliar problem into manageable steps and explain your implementation choices.
   

 • Evidence of work you can demonstrate and discuss, whether from employment, internships, coursework, independent projects or open\-source contributions.
   

  

 Recent graduates and early\-career engineers are welcome. A computer science or related degree is useful, but equivalent practical experience is welcome. You do not need prior experience in every area of the role.
   

  

 Preferred experience
   

  

 • Building web or desktop applications with responsive, accessible interfaces.
   

 • Working with relational databases, data modelling and third\-party integrations.
   

 • Deploying applications to cloud environments and using automated build, test or deployment workflows.
   

 • Working with LLM APIs, tool calling, agent workflows and evaluations.
   

 • Handling background tasks, streaming updates, session state and error recovery.
   

 • Managing permissions, credentials and sensitive data securely.
   

 • Building billing, payment reconciliation or operational software.
   

  

 Familiarity with electricity utilities, public\-sector systems or other regulated environments is a plus, not a requirement.
   

  

 How you work
   

  

 You care about whether software solves the user’s problem, not just whether the code runs.
   

  

 We value high agency: taking initiative, proposing next steps, raising blockers early and seeing work through. You should be comfortable using AI extensively while retaining the judgment to question its output, verify results and recognise when specialist input is needed.
   

  

 Ownership and growth
   

  

 You’ll take responsibility for clearly defined deliverables, with room to own larger projects as you demonstrate sound judgment and reliable execution. The scope of responsibility will reflect your experience and the requirements of each project.
   

  

 To apply
   

  

 Apply through ABV’s careers page: https://abvfirm.com/careers/software\-engineer
   

  

 Applications are reviewed through ABV’s careers page. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted with the next steps.

 About GreyLabs AI
 



 GreyLabs AI is building an enterprise\-grade Voice AI platform for the BFSI ecosystem. Our technology enables banks, insurers, NBFCs and financial\-services organizations to automate and humanize customer conversations across collections, sales, customer service and compliance.
 



 We are looking for a highly execution\-oriented Program Manager who understands how Generative AI applications are built and can translate real business requirements into effective AI agents, voice agents and chatbots.
 



 About the Role
 



 This is not a traditional project\-coordination role. You will work hands\-on with prompts, conversation flows, agent logic, integrations and testing while owning the execution of client\-facing AI programs.
 



 You will take use cases from requirement discovery and solution design through prototyping, implementation, testing and production rollout. The ideal candidate is curious about how AI systems behave, enjoys experimenting with prompts and is comfortable solving problems in a fast\-moving startup environment.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 AI Agent and Prompt Development
 


* Design, write and optimize prompts for AI agents, voice agents and chatbots.
* Convert business requirements into structured conversational flows, agent instructions, decision logic and guardrails.
* Build and configure AI agents capable of performing tasks, using tools, calling APIs and managing multi\-step conversations.
* Develop prompt frameworks covering personas, objectives, context, constraints, fallback handling and escalation logic.
* Test prompts across multiple scenarios, edge cases, customer personas, languages and conversation paths.
* Analyse agent failures, hallucinations and inconsistent responses, and continuously improve performance.
* Create evaluation frameworks and test datasets to measure accuracy, task completion, compliance and conversation quality.



 Program Execution
 


* Own AI implementation programs from discovery and POC to deployment and production go\-live.
* Create execution plans, define milestones and manage dependencies across clients, product, engineering and operations teams.
* Conduct client discussions to understand business processes and recommend suitable AI\-led workflows.
* Translate client requirements into clear product configurations, user stories and implementation documents.
* Coordinate API integrations, data requirements, UAT, issue resolution and production readiness.
* Track deliverables closely and proactively address delays, blockers and execution risks.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and speed.
* Take ownership of issues until they are completely resolved.



 Voice AI and Conversational Experience
 


* Design natural and outcome\-oriented conversations for voice and chat channels.
* Configure conversation flows for use cases such as customer service, sales, collections, lead qualification and customer onboarding.
* Work with concepts such as intent recognition, entity extraction, context retention, interruption handling, fallback responses and human\-agent handoffs.
* Collaborate with technical teams on integrations involving LLMs, APIs, ASR, TTS, telephony and enterprise systems.
* Review conversation transcripts and performance data to identify opportunities for improvement.



 Must\-Have Requirements
 


* 1–3 years of experience in AI implementation, program management, product operations, solutions, conversational AI or a related role.
* Hands\-on experience with prompt engineering and Generative AI tools.
* Demonstrable experience building or configuring at least one AI agent, voice agent, chatbot or LLM\-powered workflow.
* Understanding of LLM concepts such as system prompts, few\-shot prompting, structured outputs, tool or function calling, context management and hallucination control.
* Ability to independently test, troubleshoot and improve AI\-generated responses.

* Strong execution discipline with the ability to drive projects from idea to production.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

 Good\-to\-Have Skills
 


* Experience with agent\-building or workflow platforms such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Voiceflow, Dialogflow, Retell AI, Vapi or similar tools.
* Familiarity with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or open\-source LLM APIs.
* Exposure to RAG, vector databases, knowledge bases and multi\-agent workflows.

* Exposure to enterprise SaaS, BFSI, fintech or customer\-service automation.
* Basic proficiency in Python, SQL or low\-code automation platforms.
* Experience working directly with enterprise clients.



 What Success Looks Like
 



 Within the first few months, you should be able to:
 


* Independently convert a business use case into a working AI\-agent workflow.
* Create prompts, conversation logic, guardrails and comprehensive test scenarios.
* Manage a client implementation from requirements gathering to go\-live.
* Identify agent\-performance issues and improve outcomes through structured experimentation.
* Deliver multiple AI programs with speed, ownership and attention to detail.



 Who Will Thrive in This Role
 



 You will be a strong fit if you:
 


* Prefer building and executing over only creating plans and trackers.
* Experiment with AI tools beyond your formal responsibilities.
* Are comfortable working with ambiguity and rapidly evolving technology.
* Combine structured program management with hands\-on problem\-solving.
* Take ownership without waiting for detailed instructions.
* Are excited by the opportunity to build production\-grade AI agents for large enterprises.

title: Research Robotics
description:
We are hiring for a Research Robotics Engineer role with a fast\-growing AI company building the intelligence layer for physical\-world AI. The company is working at the intersection of robotics perception, embodied AI, egocentric video understanding, and voice\-driven interaction to develop AI systems that can perceive, reason, and act in real\-world environments.
 



  





 💡 Why Join?
 



 Work on challenging robotics and AI problems involving 3D perception, computer vision, multimodal learning, sensor data, and embodied intelligence. You'll collaborate with a strong research and engineering team to develop systems that operate in complex, real\-world environments, work on cutting\-edge research, and contribute directly to building the next generation of intelligent physical\-world systems.
 



  





 Roles and Responsibilities:
 


* **2\+ years on problems in this space.**
* **Publications in egocentric vision, 3D hand pose, VLA / VLM models, or robot learning.**
* **MS / PhD in computer vision, robotics or ML — or equivalent published research output.**
* Egocentric pose that survives the camera. We have narrowed the suspects (rectification residual, FOV, shutter type) and currently route between several public SLAM / VIO systems per clip.
* Metric 3D hand pose. Build the in\-house hand model that is stable in the world frame, and decide the representation (MANO topology, 6D vs axis\-angle) rather than inheriting it.
* Deep hands\-on work in at least two of: 3D hand / human pose reconstruction, stereo or monocular depth, VIO / SLAM, open\-vocabulary detection and segmentation, video VLMs.
* You have trained a perception model that beat an off\-the\-shelf baseline on a real domain and shipped it. Data curation, loss design and eval decisions were yours.
* Multi\-view geometry is fluent, not looked up: rectification, epipolar residual, Q matrix and depth sign conventions, triangulation, world vs camera frame.
* You can read a calibration report and say whether the problem is the camera or the model — and be right.
* Strong Python and PyTorch; you own training and inference code, not notebooks.
* Production inference experience on AWS: containerization, batch pipelines, orchestration.



  





  





**Location: Bangalore Onsite**

The Executive – Customer Service will be responsible for delivering high\-quality service to Blue Dart customers by handling inbound calls, resolving shipment\-related queries, coordinating timely pickups and deliveries, and ensuring adherence to defined customer service standards. **About Gayatri Industries**

Gayatri Industries is a precision fabrication and modular construction company established in 1987, based in Silvassa, Dadra \& Nagar Haveli. ISO 9001:2015 certified, we specialize in manufacturing portable cabins, Pre\-Engineered Buildings (PEB), and related fabricated products for clients across industrial, infrastructure, and energy sectors.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a proactive and personable **Customer Relationship Manager** to build, manage, and strengthen relationships with our clients across the order lifecycle — from initial inquiry through delivery and after\-sales support. The ideal candidate will act as the primary point of contact for customers, ensuring high satisfaction, repeat business, and smooth coordination between clients and internal teams (sales, production, and dispatch).

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the main point of contact for existing and prospective clients, addressing queries, concerns, and requirements promptly and professionally.
* Build and maintain long\-term relationships with key accounts to encourage repeat orders and referrals.
* Coordinate with the sales and business development team to follow up on leads, quotations, and order confirmations.
* Coordinate with the production and dispatch teams to track order status and proactively update customers on timelines.
* Handle post\-delivery follow\-ups, resolve complaints, and ensure timely closure of service issues.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date customer records, interaction history, and order details (in CRM software / Excel trackers as applicable).
* Gather customer feedback and share insights with management to improve products, processes, and service quality.
* Support the creation of customer satisfaction reports and periodic account reviews.
* Identify upselling/cross\-selling opportunities within the existing client base.
* Assist in preparing proposals, follow\-up emails, and client\-facing documentation as needed.

**Required Qualifications \& Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field (MBA preferred).
* Fresher or 1–2 years of experience in customer relationship management, client servicing, or a similar client\-facing role (experience in manufacturing, construction, or B2B industries preferred).
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Hindi (Gujarati is a plus).
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust and relation with clients.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word); familiarity with CRM software is an advantage.
* Good organizational skills with the ability to multitask and manage multiple client accounts simultaneously.
* Problem\-solving mindset with a customer\-first attitude.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience in the fabrication, PEB, portable cabin, or construction industry.
* Familiarity with basic order/production workflows in a manufacturing setup.

**Key Attributes**

* Professional demeanor and strong ownership mindset.
* Patience and empathy when handling client concerns.
* Comfortable working cross\-functionally with sales, production, and dispatch teams.
* Willingness to travel occasionally for client meetings/site visits, if required.

**Compensation**

As per industry standards, commensurate with experience.

title: Tea Barista Executive
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION – TEA BARISTA**

**Position: Tea Barista**

**Department: Tea Room / F\&B Operations**

**Job Purpose**

The Tea Barista is responsible for preparing and serving high\-quality tea and other beverages while ensuring excellent guest service, proper tea presentation, hygiene, and smooth day\-to\-day beverage counter operations.

The role requires good knowledge of tea varieties, brewing methods, serving standards, and the ability to create a premium and welcoming tea experience for guests.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Tea \& Beverage Preparation**

\- Prepare and serve different varieties of tea as per company recipes and SOPs.

\- Understand appropriate brewing time, temperature, quantity, and serving method for different teas.

\- Prepare hot and cold tea beverages, iced teas, specialty teas, and other approved beverages.

\- Ensure consistency in taste, quality, temperature, quantity, and presentation.

\- Prepare beverages according to approved recipes and presentation standards.

\- Handle tea leaves, herbs, milk, syrups, garnishes, and other ingredients carefully.

**2\. Guest Service**

\- Welcome guests politely and professionally.

\- Take beverage orders accurately and ensure timely service.

\- Explain tea varieties, flavours, brewing methods, and serving options to guests when required.

\- Recommend suitable teas based on guest preferences.

\- Maintain a warm, courteous, and premium service experience.

\- Handle basic guest queries and escalate complaints to the concerned senior.

**3\. Tea Knowledge**

\- Develop good knowledge of the company's tea collection and menu.

\- Learn about different tea categories, origins, flavour profiles, brewing methods, and serving styles.

\- Stay updated on new tea beverages and company product offerings.

\- Be able to explain the basic characteristics of teas to guests.

**4\. Counter \& Equipment Management**

\- Set up the tea/beverage counter before service.

\- Maintain cleanliness and proper arrangement of the tea bar.

\- Clean and maintain kettles, brewers, infusers, cups, glasses, utensils, and other equipment.

\- Ensure all equipment is used safely and correctly.

\- Complete opening and closing duties as assigned.

**5\. Hygiene \& Food Safety**

\- Maintain excellent personal grooming and hygiene.

\- Follow all company hygiene, sanitation, and food\-safety standards.

\- Keep the beverage counter, equipment, storage area, and service area clean at all times.

\- Ensure proper storage and handling of ingredients.

\- Follow FIFO and expiry\-control practices.

\- Immediately report damaged, expired, or contaminated ingredients.

**6\. Stock \& Inventory**

\- Monitor tea, milk, sugar, herbs, syrups, garnishes, disposables, and other beverage supplies.

\- Inform the supervisor about low\-stock items in advance.

\- Assist with daily stock checking and inventory counting.

\- Maintain proper portion control and minimize beverage wastage.

\- Ensure ingredients are properly stored after use.

**7\. POS \& Billing**

\- Take orders through the POS system where applicable.

\- Handle cash/card/digital payments accurately if assigned.

\- Ensure orders are entered correctly and communicated to the service team.

\- Maintain proper billing discipline.

**8\. Team Coordination**

\- Coordinate with the service, kitchen, housekeeping, and management teams.

\- Support colleagues during peak hours and special events.

\- Follow instructions from the reporting manager.

\- Maintain discipline, punctuality, teamwork, and professional conduct.

**Required Skills \& Competencies**

\- Good knowledge or interest in tea and beverage preparation.

\- Strong customer\-service and communication skills.

\- Good presentation and attention to detail.

\- Ability to follow recipes and SOPs accurately.

\- Good hygiene and grooming standards.

\- Ability to work under pressure during busy hours.

\- Team player with a positive and disciplined attitude.

\- Basic POS/cash\-handling knowledge is an advantage.

\- Willingness to learn about premium and specialty teas.

**Qualification \& Experience**

\- Minimum 10\+2 preferred.

\- Diploma/certificate in Hospitality, F\&B, or Barista training will be an advantage.

\- 6 months–2 years of experience in a café, tea room, restaurant, hotel, or beverage outlet preferred.

\- Freshers with good communication skills and a genuine interest in tea may also be considered.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

\- Tea and beverage quality \& consistency.

\- Guest satisfaction and service quality.

\- Order accuracy and service speed.

\- Compliance with recipes and SOPs.

\- Hygiene and grooming standards.

\- Proper equipment handling.

\- Stock management and wastage control.

\- Punctuality, discipline, and teamwork.

**Work Requirements**

\- Full\-time, on\-site position.

\- Flexible working hours/shifts as per Tea Room operations.

\- Willingness to work weekends and holidays as per roster.

\- Ability to stand and work at the beverage counter for extended periods.

This isn’t a marketplace or a layer on top of existing systems, we’re building the underlying technology that powers logistics, credit decisions, and compliance at scale.
 



  





 Our platform runs live operations across 900\+ pin codes and supports real\-time tracking, automated documentation, and financial decisioning across a large supply chain. Performance, reliability, and correctness matter here.

You will collaborate closely with cross functional teams to define product requirements, prioritize features, and ensure the timely delivery of high\-quality products. * Develop and maintain the product roadmap aligned with business goals and customer needs.

* Work closely with engineering, design, marketing, and sales teams to deliver products that meet market demands.

* Conduct competitive analysis and market research to inform product decisions.
* Monitor and analyze product performance metrics, and make data\-driven decisions.
* Drive product launches including working with marketing, executives, and other product management team members.
* Act as a product evangelist to build awareness and understanding internally and externally.
* Proactively identify and resolve issues that may impair the team's ability to meet strategic, financial, and technical goals.

* 2 to 6 years of experience as a Product Manager or in a similar role, preferably in a tech\-driven environment.
* Proven track record of managing all aspects of a successful product throughout its lifecycle.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a high attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to executive leadership.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, agile environment and manage multiple competing priorities.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related field (MBA preferred)

ABOUT KAVORA TECH GROUPS

Kavora Tech Groups is a next\-generation technology upskilling and career transformation platform designed for students, graduates, and working professionals aiming to thrive in the ever\-evolving tech industry.

Our mission is to bridge the gap between academic learning and industry requirements by providing hands\-on training, mentorship, and real\-world problem\-solving opportunities.

At Kavora Tech Groups, we believe that talent, when nurtured with the right resources and guidance, can unlock limitless career opportunities. Our structured ecosystem ensures that learners not only gain valuable technical knowledge but also develop the confidence and skill set needed to create a meaningful impact in the tech world.

Our learners are guided and mentored by industry veterans and tech leaders from globally recognized organizations such as Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, Netflix, and Infosys, among others.

Each program is carefully curated and vetted by experts, ensuring that the curriculum remains aligned with industry needs and prepares professionals for both cutting\-edge innovation and high\-growth career paths.

description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Position: Technical Assistant to Managing Director – Mechanical Engineering**

**Industry:** Water \& Wastewater Treatment / EPC  
**Department:** MD Office / Technical \& Projects  
**Reporting To:** Managing Director (MD)  
**Qualification:** B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering  
**Experience:** 5\-8 years preferred; exceptional freshers may be considered  
**Location:** New Delhi  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time

**Job Purpose**

The Technical Assistant to the Managing Director will provide **technical, project, operational, and coordination support directly to the MD** across the company's water and wastewater treatment business.

The role requires a Mechanical Engineer who can understand technical matters, track projects and critical activities, coordinate with internal departments, consultants, vendors and clients, and provide the MD with **accurate and timely technical updates for decision\-making**.

The candidate will act as a link between the **MD's office and Engineering, Projects, Procurement, Production, Site, Operations, and Maintenance teams**.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Technical Support to MD**

* Assist the MD in reviewing technical matters related to water and wastewater treatment projects.
* Study project drawings, BOQs, specifications, equipment datasheets, quotations, technical offers, and reports.
* Prepare concise technical summaries and presentations for the MD.
* Highlight critical technical issues, delays, risks, cost implications, and required management decisions.
* Assist the MD in evaluating technical proposals from vendors, consultants, contractors, and project teams.
* Conduct technical research on new equipment, technologies, products, and treatment solutions.
* Maintain a systematic record of important technical decisions and action points.

**2\. Project Monitoring \& Coordination**

* Monitor the progress of ongoing WTP, STP, ETP, RO and other water\-treatment projects.
* Coordinate with Project Managers, Site Engineers, Design Engineers, Procurement, and other departments to obtain project updates.
* Track project milestones, equipment deliveries, installation, erection, testing, commissioning, and handover.
* Prepare **daily/weekly/monthly project status reports** for the MD.
* Identify delays and bottlenecks and bring them to the MD's attention with relevant facts and possible solutions.
* Follow up on action items assigned by the MD and ensure timely closure.
* Maintain a project\-wise **action tracker and management dashboard**.

**3\. Engineering \& Mechanical Responsibilities**

* Review mechanical aspects of water\-treatment projects under the direction of senior management.
* Understand and review:
* Pumps and pumping systems
* Piping systems
* Valves and fittings
* Pressure vessels
* Filters
* Agitators and mixers
* Blowers and compressors
* Dosing systems
* Clarifiers and sludge\-handling systems
* RO/UF equipment
* Mechanical equipment and packages
* Read and understand P\&IDs, GA drawings, equipment layouts, datasheets, BOQs, and mechanical specifications.
* Assist in identifying technical discrepancies between drawings, specifications, offers, and actual site conditions.
* Coordinate with engineering teams for technical clarifications and modifications.

**4\. Vendor \& Procurement Coordination**

* Assist the MD in reviewing major equipment and vendor proposals.
* Coordinate with vendors for technical offers, drawings, datasheets, inspection reports, delivery schedules, and pending documents.
* Assist in preparing technical comparison statements for equipment and machinery.
* Track critical procurement items and highlight delays.
* Coordinate with procurement and technical teams to ensure timely ordering and delivery of project\-critical equipment.
* Participate in vendor meetings when required and prepare meeting notes/action points.

**5\. Site \& Project Visits**

* Visit project sites with the MD or independently when required.
* Monitor mechanical installation, erection, testing, and commissioning activities.
* Interact with site teams, contractors, consultants, and clients on technical matters.
* Verify reported site issues and provide factual updates to the MD.
* Prepare site visit reports with photographs, observations, pending actions, and recommendations.
* Follow up on site\-related issues until closure.

**6\. Management Reporting \& MIS**

Prepare and maintain management reports covering:

* Project progress
* Engineering status
* Procurement status
* Equipment delivery
* Site execution
* Commissioning status
* Major technical issues
* Client/consultant issues
* Pending approvals
* Vendor performance
* Project risks and delays
* Action items assigned by MD

The candidate should be capable of converting detailed technical information into **short, clear management\-level updates**.

**7\. Coordination with Departments**

Act as a coordination point between the MD and:

* Design \& Engineering
* Project Execution
* Procurement
* Production/Fabrication
* Site Operations
* Commissioning
* Maintenance
* Quality
* Commercial/Contracts
* Sales/Business Development

Ensure that important instructions from the MD are communicated to the relevant teams and followed through to completion.

**8\. New Technology \& Business Support**

* Research emerging technologies in water and wastewater treatment.
* Study new mechanical equipment and treatment solutions available in the market.
* Assist the MD in evaluating potential technology partners and suppliers.
* Support preparation of technical presentations for clients and business meetings.
* Assist in technical due diligence for new projects and opportunities.
* Collect and analyze market/competitor technical information when required.

**Required Technical Knowledge**

The candidate should have a good understanding of:

* Water Treatment Plants (WTP)
* Sewage Treatment Plants (STP)
* Effluent Treatment Plants (ETP)
* Reverse Osmosis (RO)
* Ultrafiltration (UF)
* MEE/ZLD systems – basic understanding preferred
* Pumping systems
* Mechanical equipment
* Piping and valves
* Equipment selection and specifications
* Mechanical erection and commissioning
* Preventive maintenance
* P\&IDs and GA drawings
* BOQ/BOM and technical specifications

**Required Skills**

* Strong Mechanical Engineering fundamentals
* Excellent MS Excel and PowerPoint skills
* Good knowledge of MS Word and documentation
* Ability to read engineering drawings and P\&IDs
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Strong follow\-up and coordination ability
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Ability to prepare professional management reports
* Ability to work with senior management and cross\-functional teams
* Willingness to travel to project sites

**Personal Attributes**

The ideal candidate should be:

* **Highly organized and disciplined**
* Proactive rather than waiting for instructions
* Comfortable working directly with the MD
* Strong in follow\-up and execution
* Technically curious and willing to learn
* Good at handling confidential business information
* Capable of working under pressure and managing multiple priorities
* Detail\-oriented but able to understand the overall business objective
* Professional in dealing with clients, consultants, vendors, and employees

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Timely and accurate reporting to the MD.
* Effective tracking and closure of MD action points.
* Accuracy of project status information.
* Identification and escalation of project risks and delays.
* Effective coordination between departments.
* Timely follow\-up with vendors and project teams.
* Quality of technical analysis and documentation.
* Timely completion of assigned technical projects.
* Reduction in delays through proactive coordination.
* Quality and usefulness of information provided to the MD for decision\-making.

**Authority \& Role Positioning**

The Technical Assistant will **not replace functional/project heads** but will support the MD by ensuring that important technical and project information reaches the MD accurately and that decisions/action points are followed through.

The position requires a combination of **Mechanical Engineering knowledge \+ project understanding \+ management reporting \+ strong coordination and follow\-up skills**.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

**Education:** B.E./B.Tech – Mechanical Engineering  
**Experience:** 2–5 years in Water Treatment, Wastewater Treatment, EPC, Mechanical Projects, or related engineering industry.

Candidates with experience in **WTP/STP/ETP/RO projects, mechanical equipment, EPC execution, project coordination, or management reporting** will be preferred.

**Reporting:** Directly to Managing Director

**Salary:** As per candidate's experience and company policy.

**Location:** New Delhi

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

* Basic to good understanding of **UI/UX design principles**.

* Good understanding of layouts, typography, colors, spacing and visual hierarchy.
* Ability to create clean, modern and professional website designs.
* Basic understanding of responsive web design.
* Ability to convert a design concept into an actual working webpage.
* Comfortable experimenting with **AI tools for design and productivity**.

Tools You May Work With

* Canva
* ChatGPT and other AI tools
* AI image\-generation/design tools
* Other tools that help improve the design workflow

You do **not** need to know every tool listed above. What matters most is your ability to create good designs and implement them effectively.

* Real\-world UI/UX design for a business website
* Designing and implementing websites using Wix
* Responsive web design
* Website structure and user experience
* Design systems and visual consistency
* Using AI tools in a professional design workflow

* Generate and release employee payslips.
* Maintain accurate payroll and employee records.
* Support PF, ESIC, and Professional Tax enrollment and monthly/periodic returns.

**5\. Employee Relations \& Grievance Handling**

* Handle employee grievances and coordinate with the relevant teams for resolution.
* Maintain positive relationships with shop\-floor and blue\-collar employees.
* Escalate critical employee issues to HR management on time.

**6\. Shop\-Floor HR \& Workforce Monitoring**

* Interact with employees and supervisors on a daily basis.
* Monitor discipline, workforce behavior, and adherence to workplace rules.
* Support management in resolving day\-to\-day workforce issues.

**7\. Safety \& Compliance**

**Location:** CBD Belapur  
**Work Coverage:** PAN India  
**Reporting To:** DGM

**Job Purpose**

The HR Executive will be responsible for end\-to\-end coordination of engineers deployed across PAN India. The role will involve engineer recruitment, joining formalities, attendance and deployment monitoring, inspection/site coordination, employee records, exit formalities and final settlement support.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. PAN India Engineer Recruitment**

* Handle end\-to\-end recruitment of engineers for PAN India locations.
* Understand manpower requirements from different projects/sites and initiate recruitment accordingly.
* Source candidates through job portals, recruitment channels, references and other available sources.
* Screen candidates based on qualification, experience, technical requirements and location.
* Coordinate interviews with the concerned technical/management team.
* Follow up with selected candidates until joining.
* Maintain recruitment tracker and provide regular recruitment status reports.

**2\. Engineer Joining \& Onboarding**

* Complete end\-to\-end joining formalities of engineers.
* Collect and verify required joining documents such as:
* Aadhaar / PAN
* Educational certificates
* Experience documents
* Bank details
* Photographs
* Address proof
* Other company\-required documents
* Prepare and maintain employee personal files and digital records.
* Coordinate appointment letters, joining forms and other HR documentation.
* Ensure new engineers are properly briefed regarding company policies, attendance, reporting and site requirements.

**3\. PAN India Attendance \& Deployment Monitoring**

* Monitor daily attendance of engineers deployed at different locations across India.
* Maintain location\-wise and employee\-wise attendance records.
* Track engineer deployment, transfer, leave and absence.
* Follow up with engineers and reporting managers for attendance discrepancies.
* Prepare daily/weekly/monthly attendance MIS.
* Identify unauthorized absence, late reporting and attendance irregularities and escalate the same to the concerned authority.

**4\. Site / Inspection Attendance Monitoring**

* Maintain the schedule of inspections/site visits assigned to engineers.
* Monitor whether engineers are reaching the assigned inspection/site location on time.
* Coordinate with engineers regarding reporting time and site requirements.
* Take regular attendance/status confirmation from engineers during inspections wherever required.
* Maintain inspection deployment and reporting records.
* Immediately escalate cases of delayed reporting, non\-reporting or absence from assigned inspection.

**5\. Engineer Coordination**

* Act as the primary HR coordination point for engineers deployed across PAN India.
* Maintain regular communication with engineers regarding attendance, deployment, leave and HR\-related matters.
* Coordinate with project/site teams regarding manpower availability.
* Resolve routine HR and documentation\-related queries of engineers.
* Maintain updated employee contact and deployment details.

**6\. Leave \& Absence Management**

* Receive and record leave requests from engineers.
* Maintain leave and attendance records.
* Coordinate leave approvals with reporting managers.
* Monitor prolonged absence and unauthorized leave.
* Update the HR tracker regularly.

**7\. Employee Exit \& Full \& Final Settlement**

* Handle engineer exit formalities from resignation to relieving.
* Collect resignation and coordinate notice\-period requirements.
* Prepare exit checklist and ensure completion of clearance formalities.
* Coordinate with relevant departments for company assets, documents and dues.
* Prepare inputs for Full \& Final Settlement.
* Coordinate salary, leave balance, deductions, notice\-period recovery and other settlement\-related information.
* Ensure relieving/experience documentation is completed as per company process.

**8\. HR MIS \& Documentation**

* Maintain updated employee database and HR records.
* Prepare regular MIS related to:
* Recruitment
* Joining
* Headcount
* Attendance
* Leave
* Engineer deployment
* Inspection reporting
* Exit
* Full \& Final Settlement
* Maintain trackers and ensure data accuracy.
* Prepare reports for management review.

**Candidate Profile**

* Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in HR will be an advantage.
* **2–4 years of experience in HR operations/recruitment.**
* Experience in **field workforce / engineer recruitment / site manpower coordination** will be preferred.
* Good knowledge of recruitment and employee lifecycle processes.
* Strong follow\-up and coordination skills.
* Comfortable coordinating with employees across different locations in India.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel and HR MIS.
* Good communication skills in English and Hindi.
* Ability to manage multiple requirements and follow up with employees continuously.
* Willingness to coordinate beyond normal office hours when required for PAN India site/inspection activities.

**Key Skills**

* PAN India Recruitment
* Engineer Hiring
* Employee Coordination
* Attendance Management
* Site/Inspection Monitoring
* HR Operations
* Joining \& Onboarding
* Exit Formalities
* Full \& Final Settlement
* HR MIS
* MS Excel
* Strong Follow\-up
* Communication Skills
* Multitasking

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Recruitment closure within required timelines.
* Timely completion of engineer joining formalities.
* Accuracy of attendance and deployment records.
* Timely monitoring and reporting of inspection attendance.
* Reduction in attendance/reporting discrepancies.
* Timely completion of exit formalities and F\&F inputs.
* Accuracy and timely submission of HR MIS.
* Employee coordination and response time.

* Manage job postings, candidate follow\-ups, interview scheduling, salary negotiations, and offer rollouts.

* Support performance management, appraisal cycles, probation reviews, and employee development.

6\. HR MIS, Reporting \& Management Support

* Prepare and maintain HR MIS reports relating to headcount, recruitment, attrition, attendance, payroll, and compliance.
* Prepare monthly HR dashboards and management reports.
* Monitor employee attendance, absenteeism, and workforce\-related data.
* Support HR audits, process improvements, and management reviews.
* Perform other HR\-related responsibilities assigned by management.

Required Qualifications \& Experience

* 4–6 years of relevant experience in HR operations, payroll, statutory compliance, and employee management.

Required Skills

* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and coordination skills.
* Strong problem\-solving, decision\-making, and organizational abilities.

* Good leadership skills, attention to detail, and a high level of confidentiality.

Preferred Candidate Profile

description:
**Company Description**  

Egis is a leading global consulting, construction engineering and operating firm. We work together with our clients, across every aspect of transport, energy, and the built environment to build a more balanced, sustainable, and resilient world. The Egis Group has more than 50 years of experience and a team of 25,500 employees in over 70 countries around the world. Joining our Group means, above all, sharing our values as a people\-first company, strongly committed to sustainability and innovation.


In the UK and Ireland, we are proud to be delivering some of the most iconic projects which help connect people, protect our environment, and meet emission reduction targets. From highways, rail and operations and maintenance, to energy, water, nuclear and smart infrastructure, clients choose us to help them solve their most complex challenges \- delivering climate\-responsible growth that meets the needs of communities, industry and the planet.

 **Job Description**  

Reporting to the GSSC Talent Acquisition Lead, with an operational link to the UK\&I Talent Acquisition team, the Talent Sourcing Partner will provide dedicated sourcing, headhunting, market mapping and candidate identification support across UK\&I recruitment activity.


The role is designed to support all UK\&I business lines, flexing across different markets depending on recruitment demand and business priority. This may include Transport, O\&M, Water, Nuclear, Defence, Architecture, PMCM, Commercial, Engineering, Aviation, Buildings, Early Careers and Ireland. While the role is generalist in coverage, it may develop specialist knowledge in priority markets where demand, scarcity or growth requires deeper sourcing focus.


This role is part of the proposed UK\&I hybrid Talent Acquisition operating model. The Talent Sourcing Partner will operate from GSSC India and support in\-country Talent Acquisition Partners and Senior Talent Acquisition Partners by building candidate pipelines, identifying passive talent, creating market maps, maintaining talent communities and supporting hard\-to\-fill recruitment campaigns.


The Talent Sourcing Partner will help move UK\&I Talent Acquisition away from reactive requisition\-by\-requisition recruitment towards proactive talent supply, supporting growth, future capability and delivery resilience.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Support sourcing activity across all UK\&I business lines, flexing between markets based on recruitment demand and business priority
* Build specialist market knowledge in priority areas where required, such as Nuclear, Water, Transport, O\&M, Architecture, PMCM, Ireland or Early Careers
* Partner with UK\&I Talent Acquisition Partners and Senior Talent Acquisition Partners to understand role requirements, target skills, locations, salary ranges, competitor markets and sourcing priorities
* Build candidate longlists for live vacancies and future pipeline requirements across specialist, operational, technical, commercial and project\-led roles • Conduct market mapping to identify target companies, competitor organisations, project teams, skill clusters and passive candidate pools

Requisition Number: 62525
Job Location: Bangalore, IND
Global Grade: Band 8
Work Type: Office Working
Employment Type: Permanent
Posting Start Date: 22/09/2026
Posting End Date: 26/09/2026
:
**Job Summary**
---------------

The Operational, Technology and Cyber Risk (OTCR) organisation is instrumental in protecting and ensuring the resilience of Standard Chartered Bank’s operations, data, and IT systems by managing operational, technology and cyber risk across the enterprise. As a critical function reporting into the Group Chief Risk Officer (CRO), the Group OTCR team serves as the second line of defense for assuring that controls are implemented effectively, in accordance with the OTCR Framework, and for instilling a risk culture within the Bank.  



The Assistant Manager, OTCR Reporting is a permanent role that requires knowledge and experience in data management and governance, development and delivery of internal risk reporting, a deep understanding of the Group’s operational risk events’ standards and a holistic understanding to regulatory expectations on operational loss reporting and data analytics. This role reports directly to the Senior Manager, OTCR Data Governance, Reporting \& Analytics.  



The purpose of this role is to implement a robust data governance around internal risk reporting framework, identify and enable utilization of accurate and timely risk data, and deliver business efficiencies through automation and process optimization.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Internal Risk Reporting:**  

• Responsibility for production of OTCR Risk Information Reports for regions, countries, businesses and functions within the Bank.
  

• Identify and respond to MI and reporting requirements to support the internal reporting requirements and committee paper preparations. Addressing the senior management requests for management information and reporting packs and updates.
  

• Lead multi\-business/function forums and working groups to solution for risk reporting issues, identify actions and drive remediation to completion.
  

• Lead engagement with key stakeholders to ensure that key risk drivers and business rationales are reflected in the commentary of risk reporting and that adequate attention is drawn on key insights from risk analysis.
  

• Determine new risk reporting requirements of the bank, continually enhance existing risk information reports and conceptualise development of risk information reports at appropriate levels of granularity.
  

• Implement automated solutions to monitor data quality and issue resolution
  

• Set up processes with embedded best in class data management practices


**To deliver this the role holder must have:**  

• Ability to identify and analyze risk data and communicate data\-driven insights to wider audience with diverse background
  

• A collaborative approach to ensure that the needs of stakeholders can be met, in order to support effective risk identification, prioritization and remediation
  

• An ability to drive innovation and change so as to enhance processes and achieve efficiencies and investment in people to ensure that staff are fully supported to be here for good.


**Role Specific Responsibilities:**  

**Strategy**  

• Prepare reports, packs and MI for senior committees and forums.
  

• Resolve audit findings; open/close related operational risk issues.
  

• Maintain a mature OTCR risk reporting process, including effective change management.
  

• Support OTCR risk type by monitoring OTCR compliance, informing about risk metrics and quarterly risk assessments, and improving control efficiency.
  

• Develop and support the strategic planning process (incl. prioritisation of strategic initiatives)
  

• Support the establishment of good culture and corporate identity by developing mission / value statements
  

• Align processes, resources\-planning and objectives with the strategy
  

• Provide support and insight into significant organizational changes (e.g., shift in strategic focus)
  

• Support business/ strategic planning activities by providing financial budgets and forecasts
  

• Address audit issues as they arise, incl. creation and closure of operational risk issues related to specific audit findings
  

• Support in the preparation of reports, packs and MI to senior executives including to the Board as required and Regulators
  

• Drive the strategic intent and agenda of the OTCR organisation through excellent reporting, data and MI, processes, and creating visibility of top risks across the Management Team
  

• Management of headcount, workforce governance, vacancies, and succession planning
  

• Communicate risk intelligence to stakeholders for principle and sub\-risk types of OTCR
  

• Prepare and present communications and MI to senior management
  

• Contribute to the development of performance management processes, to encourage the development of an appropriate risk culture and discipline.
  

• Establish and maintain a mature Risk Reporting Process for OTCR, including effective and efficient change management
  

• Support the Executive Director, OTCR Data Governance, Reporting and Analytics to build data analytics capabilities in the team with the aim to monitor compliance with OTCR requirements and provide insights for the risk metrics


**Business**  

• Develop and maintain OTCR risk reporting capabilities, tools and processes to meet business needs.
  

• Deliver timely and accurate OTCR risk reports.
  

• Improve data management, governance and reporting through appropriate tools, automation and best practices.
  

• Strengthen data quality controls, escalate issues and support effective continuous monitoring.
  

• Partner with OTCR data owners to leverage data for risk reporting and insights.
  

• Maintain clear documentation and control requirements for the risk reporting process


**Processes**  

• Support the build of a mature and sustainable process to deliver timely and accurate OTCR Risk Metrics (data about for example Risk Events, Elevated Residual Risks, ICS Culture Quotient)
  

• Provide commentary \& insights to OTCR Risk Metrics
  

• Regularly review the monthly and quarterly performance of risk metrics, identifying any patterns, deteriorating trends, or emerging risks for escalation to the RFO or designated delegate.
  

• Monitor and manage the quality of data used in the OTCR Risk Reporting process (identify and assess issues, monitor closure and mitigation of those issues)
  

• Collaborate with OTCR Data Providers for timely and accurate metric results as well as metric reading
  

• Handle Manual Adjustments related to OTCR Risk Metrics (identification, impact assessment, documentation in central repository)
  

• Establish and maintain OTCR Risk Metrics documentation (including Report Specification, Metric Calculation Logic, List of Critical Risk Measures, List of Critical Data Elements)
  

• Engage in change risk and impact assessment for reporting changes triggered by Policy, System, Regulatory Changes
  

• Contribute to the design and implementation of effective continuous monitoring for Data Quality
  

• Support RCSA for the OTCR Risk Reporting process by providing challenges during KCI design and automations as well as evidencing for existing KCI attestation.
  

• Continuously look for areas to improve the operational efficiency and effectiveness of the OTCR risk management processes through optimization and automation


**Risk Management**  

• Define and design appropriate MI and communicate via reporting to relevant committees.
  

• Embed appropriate data quality controls and provide analysis to support effective Risk Management
  

• Ensure that all activities are in line with and support of the OTCR principal risk type under the Bank’s ERMF
  

• Ensure all activities are in line with and support the relevant data management and risk reporting internal polices and standards and external regulatory requirements and obligations
  

• Identify and assess the impact of data quality issues, analyse the root cause and escalate when necessary
  

• Provide commentary \& insights to critical and context OTCR risk metrics
  

• Ensure early identification and escalation of risks, issues, trends and developments to OTCR and relevant stakeholders.
  

• Provide insight and guidance on the interpretation of reported exceptions/analytics outputs so that appropriate actions can be taken by the Group OTCR function


**Governance**  

The role holder is responsible for the following:
  

• Building a strong risk culture and good conduct in the OTCR organization
  

• Ensure compliance with Group Data Conduct Policy and its standards, Group Data Management Policy and its standards, Risk Reporting and Risk Data Aggregation Standards, and all other standards related to management and utilization of risk data, and risk reporting


**Regulatory \& Business Conduct**  

• Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  

• Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  

• Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
  

• Demonstrating leadership ability to ensure that the team achieves the outcomes set out in the Bank's Conduct Risk framework.


**Key stakeholders**  

• OTCR LT
  

• OTCR SPOC
  

• Risk \& CFCC COO
  

• Regional CRO
  

• Country OTCR Teams
  

• Global Head Reporting, Risk \& CFCC
  

• Group CISO Teams
  

• TTO Data Domain Owner
  

• Group CDO Teams
  

• HR Learning Capability
  

• Risk BPM Team
  

• Head Audit


**Other Responsibilities**  

Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in the team; Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures; Multiple functions (double hats);


**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

**Must\-have Skills**  

• Risk and Compliance
  

• Risk Reporting and Data Governance
  

• Analytical Thinking


**Other Skills**  

• Microsoft Excel and Data Analysis
  

• Effective Communication
  

• Business Partnering
  

• Business Process Improvement and Change Managementa


**Motivations**
---------------

• Solving complex risk\-data and reporting problems with disciplined analysis and sound judgement.
  

• Turning data into clear insights that strengthen senior\-management and committee decision\-making.
  

• Improving controls, data quality and reporting processes through collaboration, innovation and sustainable automation.


**Qualifications**
------------------

**Key Experiences**  

• Experience in OTCR or operational risk reporting, risk metrics, data governance and management information.
  

• Experience producing senior committee packs and communicating data\-driven insights to diverse stakeholders.
  

• Experience with data\-quality controls, RCSA/KCI processes, audit or issue remediation, change delivery and process automation.
  

• Advanced Microsoft Excel capability; knowledge of SQL and data visualisation tools is advantageous.


**Certifications / Qualifications (only where mandatory)**  

• Industry related qualification in Operational Risk Management or Information \& Cyber Security, such as CISSP, CISM(P), and/or CRISC or equivalent experience
  

• Degree level education or equivalent


**Languages**  

• English


**About Standard Chartered**
----------------------------

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.


Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.


Together we:


* **Do the right thing** and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
* **Never settle,** continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* **Are better together,** we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term
**What we offer**
-----------------

**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,** we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.


* **Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance,** with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* **Time\-off** including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* **Flexible working** options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* **Proactive wellbeing support** through Unmind, a market\-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first\-aiders and all sorts of self\-help toolkits
* **A continuous learning culture** to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
* **Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation,** one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies \- everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

title: People Advisory Consultant
description:
We support peace and prosperity by building connections, understanding and trust between people in the UK and countries worldwide. For 90 years we have shaped brighter futures through education, arts, culture, language, and creativity.


Working with people in over 200 countries and territories, we are on the ground in more than 100 countries.


**We connect. We inspire.**

**The Role**The People Advisory Consultant will provide expert, short\-term People Function support to the rapidly growing Shared Services Centre in Noida, addressing immediate HR and employee relations priorities. The role will provide practical, risk\-based advice on complex people matters, support senior stakeholders and managers, and strengthen leadership, management capability and organisational culture.  

The role will also assess the longer\-term People Function requirements of the Shared Services Centre and provide evidence\-based recommendations on the future service model, capability, capacity and resources needed. Reporting to the Head of APAC People Solutions, the consultant will work closely with SSC leadership, managers, People Function and global specialist teams to stabilise current priorities while designing sustainable support for continued growth.  

**Main responsibilities**The People Advisory Consultant will provide expert HR and employee relations advice on complex, sensitive and high\-risk matters, assessing priorities, risks and required actions. The role will support managers and senior stakeholders with fair, consistent and timely solutions, ensuring alignment with organisational policies, employment requirements and risk considerations. It will also identify recurring issues, cultural and management capability gaps, and provide practical recommendations to strengthen leadership and people management.  

The role will assess the current and future People Function requirements of the Shared Services Centre, developing evidence\-based recommendations on service model, capability, capacity, resourcing and associated costs. It will work closely with People Partners, Employee Relations, specialist teams and SSC leadership to establish priorities, clarify accountability and develop an implementation plan for sustainable support.  

The consultant will bring together people data, stakeholder insight and case experience to identify themes and underlying causes, translating findings into clear, prioritised actions. The role will monitor progress, highlight emerging risks and provide senior stakeholders with clear recommendations to support immediate interventions and longer\-term People Function planning.

* Assesses organisational capability, capacity and future people requirements.
* Use evidence and insight to inform recommendations and decision\-making.

* Knowledge of the Indian labour legislation
  

**Language Requirements*** The British Council systems and global processes operate in English. Written and verbal proficiency in English is required.
