title: Mechatronics Engineer
description:
We're looking for mavericks \- inventors at heart, people who get genuinely fired up by a hard problem, not intimidated by it.
 





 If you take things apart just to understand them, to get to the heart of machines, and then put them back together making it whole again; if you'd rather chase an unsolved problem than polish a solved one; and if "build something that matters" excites you \- come build it with us.
 




  






 We're building the electromechanical core of surgical robots \- actuators, sensors, and control loops that have to work flawlessly because there's a patient on the other end of it. The problems here aren't solved. You'll define the architecture, build the first proof\-of\-concept, watch it fail, and dig into why \- across electronics, embedded systems, and mechanical hardware, sometimes all in one afternoon.
 




  





**What you'll actually be doing** 



* Architecting electromechanical subsystems from the ground up \- not filling in someone else's spec.
* Getting your hands dirty across electronics, embedded systems, and mechanical integration.
* Building and breaking POCs \- then figuring out what the failure is actually telling you.
* Designing test jigs, fixtures, and validation processes that don't exist yet.
* Benchmarking motors, encoders, and sensors to squeeze out real performance data.
* Living in oscilloscopes, multimeters, and logic analyzers when things misbehave.
* Writing scrappy C/C\+\+ firmware fast enough to test an idea before it goes stale.
* Working shoulder\-to\-shoulder with electronics, embedded, mechanical, and clinical teams \-
* because nothing here ships in isolation.



  





**Who we're looking for** 



* You've got 2\-5 years in electromechanical integration or robotics, and a degree in Mechatronics, Robotics, Electrical, Electronics, or something adjacent \- but what matters more is that you've actually built things.
* You've prototyped subsystems, defined harnesses, and validated hardware with your own hands, not just on paper.
* You understand motors, encoders, sensors, and control systems at a gut level.
* You're comfortable in C/C\+\+ and know your way around a bench full of test equipment.
* You're the kind of person who says "let me try something" before "let me check the spec" \- genuinely energized by problems that don't have an obvious answer yet.



  





**What you get** 



* Real ownership \- your subsystem, your calls, your name on it.
* A front\-row seat across electronics, embedded, and mechanical domains \- not a narrow lane.
* A team of mavericks who'd rather solve a hard problem than avoid one.

title: Controls & Electronics Engineer, Industrial Automation and Defect Detection
description:
**Controls \& Electronics Engineer, Industrial Automation and Defect Detection** 




 NITS Engineering, Computer Vision and Industrial Automation Division
 



**Location:** 
 New Delhi, India
 



**Type:** 
 Full time
 



  





**About the Division** 




 NITS Engineering's Computer Vision and Industrial Automation Division builds the machine vision, controls, and automation systems that power precision manufacturing across the company's product lines, from biofabrication system to a growing range of automated defect detection systems. The division works at the intersection of industrial electronics, PLC based control, and machine vision, developing systems that catch defects, drive quality decisions, and keep manufacturing lines running reliably. As the division scales, it is expanding its automation, controls, and computer vision capability to support new product lines and manufacturing processes across NITS Engineering.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Controls \& Electronics Engineer to join the division and lead the PLC development of industrial automation and defect detection systems, starting with our existing bottle cap defect detection and extending to other advanced engineering platforms as the division's scope grows. The role also supports broader automation systems work as needed.
 



 The role spans PLC based machine control, motion systems, sensors, actuators, machine vision, industrial electronics, temperature control, and fluidic systems, with a particular focus on building automated defect detection capability into our platforms. You will work across the complete system, from selecting and integrating components and developing control and vision based inspection logic, to wiring, commissioning, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of the machine.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 




*Defect Detection and Machine Vision (Computer Vision Division)* 



* Develop and integrate machine vision based defect detection systems, including cameras, lighting, triggering, image acquisition, and inspection logic.
* Define detection criteria and inspection routines for bioprinting and biofabrication processes, working closely with process and biomedical engineering teams.
* Integrate machine vision output with PLC control logic to enable automated pass or fail decisions, alarms, and corrective actions.
* Continuously refine detection accuracy and reliability as new failure modes are identified.



*Industrial Automation and Controls* 



* Develop PLC based control systems using platforms such as Siemens S7\-1200 and TIA Portal.
* Design and implement machine control logic, sequencing, interlocks, alarms, and HMI interfaces.
* Integrate stepper and servo motors, motor drivers, encoders, limit switches, sensors, heaters, valves, pumps, and other actuators.
* Develop electrical architectures for 3D bioprinters, including power distribution, control panels, SMPS, relays, protection, wiring, connectors, and machine I/O.
* Integrate temperature control systems including heaters, RTDs, thermocouples, and temperature controllers.
* Integrate pressure, flow, position, optical, and other sensors used in dispensing and fluidic systems.
* Implement industrial communication and networking between PLCs, drives, sensors, cameras, embedded controllers, and industrial PCs.



*Electrical Build and Support* 



* Build, wire, test, and troubleshoot electrical and electronic assemblies and control panels.
* Diagnose electrical noise, grounding, signal integrity, communication, timing, and control system issues.
* Prepare electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, I/O lists, BOMs, and technical documentation.
* Commission machines and work with mechanical, software, and fluidics engineers during system integration and testing.



*Biofabrication Systems Support* 



* Contribute automation and controls expertise to broader biofabrication platform development as projects require.
* Collaborate with the biofabrication and biomedical engineering teams on process automation, sensing, and system reliability.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, or a related discipline.
* 2 to 5 years of relevant hands\-on experience in industrial automation, machine controls, electronics integration, robotics, or hardware development.
* Practical experience with PLC programming and industrial control systems.
* Exposure to machine vision or computer vision based inspection systems, or strong interest in developing this capability.
* Ability to design and troubleshoot electrical circuits, control panels, and machine wiring.
* Strong understanding of sensors, relays, solenoids, motor drivers, actuators, power supplies, and industrial I/O.
* Experience with stepper or servo motion systems and machine level motion control.
* Ability to read and create electrical schematics and wiring diagrams.
* Hands on experience using multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, and other electrical test equipment.
* Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to diagnose problems across electrical, electronic, mechanical, and software interfaces.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience with Siemens S7\-1200, TIA Portal, HMI, and PROFINET.
* Experience with industrial machine vision, cameras, lighting, triggering, and image acquisition, or basic computer vision or image processing tools.
* Experience with pneumatic systems, solenoid valves, pumps, pressure control, or fluidic systems.
* Experience with temperature control systems and PID control.
* Familiarity with Modbus TCP, EtherNet/IP, CAN, RS\-485, or other industrial communication protocols.
* Experience with Raspberry Pi, STM32, ESP32, or other embedded platforms.
* Basic PCB design or electronics prototyping experience.
* Experience integrating electronics, controls, or vision systems into 3D printers, robotics, laboratory equipment, or other precision machines.
* Basic Python or C/C\+\+ for hardware interfacing, testing, or vision pipeline development.



  





**Why Join** 



* Help build and shape the Computer Vision and Industrial Automation Division from an early stage, with direct ownership of our defect detection systems.
* Work directly on the electrical, control, and vision architecture of advanced 3D bioprinters and biomedical systems.
* Own control, electronics, and inspection subsystems from component selection through integration, commissioning, and testing.
* Gain exposure to biofabrication systems and processes alongside core automation work.
* Access to in house prototyping, fabrication, electronics, and testing facilities.
* Work closely with mechanical, fluidics, software, and biomedical engineering teams.
* A fast moving engineering environment with substantial technical responsibility and room to grow.



  





**How to Apply** 




 Applicants who do not fully meet every point above but demonstrate strong potential and relevant hands on experience are encouraged to apply. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled. Our pre\-selection process is conducted by our recruiters directly, not by artificial intelligence.
 



 Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for next steps. Applications sent directly to the email address will not be accepted or entertained.
 



 To apply, please fill out the application form and include links to any past projects, prototypes, control systems, or vision and inspection systems demonstrating your automation, electronics, or computer vision experience.

title: Medical Reviewer (Contract)
description:
Job description:
**This is a 4\-month contract position, with potential conversion to full\-time depending on performance and client requirements.We are looking only for candidates who can join immediately.**
CACTUS is a remote\-first organization and we embrace an accelerate from anywhere culture. You may be required to travel to our Mumbai office based on business requirements or for company/team events.
If you're looking for a role that allows you to combine your passion for medical science with your attention to detail, the Medical Reviewer position offers a unique and rewarding opportunity. This position gives you the chance to make a significant impact by ensuring that medical content is accurate, clear, and compliant with industry standards.
Job responsibilities:
* Evaluate manuscripts, posters, slide decks, educational material, medical literature, etc., provided by clients for data accuracy.
* Check documents (mentioned above) developed by medical writers for scientific data errors by checking the developed material against annotated references, CSRs, other source data.
* Check for discrepancy within text, discrepancy between figures/tables, and between text and supplementary material, and make suggestions for improvements.
* Identify missing sources in documents and gaps in scientific logic.
* Check for grammar, syntax, style, and compliance with style guides, regulatory guidelines, and publishing requirements.
* Be responsible for the quality of the documents/projects fact checked/QCed.
* Ensure effective communication of QC/fact check findings with the client/medical writers.
* Deliver QC reports to the stakeholders and identify quality trends.
* Ensure timely delivery of documents.
* Effectively and proactively communicate with team members, authors/faculty, clients, and vendors.
* Attend workshops/seminars/trainings to hone your skills and contribute to organizational objectives.


\#LI\-Remote
Qualifications and prerequisites:
* Minimum 2 years of experience in the medical writing industry; freshers with substantial knowledge of the publication landscape or clinical research are also eligible.
* Master’s degree in research, or equivalent industry experience.
* Ability to work efficiently and independently, multitask, and prioritize.
* Excellent attention to detail and zero tolerance to errors.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills.
* Functional with MS Office.
* Flexible and adaptable to changing project priorities and work assignments.


Application process:

Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process typically involves an initial screening by a recruiter, a technical assessment, and two to three interview rounds. For this role, the process starts with a **Technical Assessment**, where candidates will have agreed upon timeline to complete the task, followed by a **Technical Interview** with the Hiring Managers. All interactions will be conducted virtually via **MS Teams**. **AI at Cactus Life Sciences**
The life sciences industry is undergoing a fundamental shift in how scientific knowledge is created, communicated, and delivered. We are building our work around it.
AI is embedded meaningfully across everything we do, through proprietary platforms purpose\-built for life sciences and generative tools that deliver measurable value to our clients. It is core to how we operate, and an expected way of working for everyone who joins us.
We believe in Human\-Anchored AI™: whatever your discipline \- science, communications, strategy, or operations, you will work in an environment where AI augments your expertise rather than replaces it.
You will build skills that are in genuine demand and still taking shape across the industry. If you are curious and focused on building capabilities for the world where human intelligence meets artificial intelligence, this is where you belong. **Equal Opportunity**
Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.  


About Us:

Cactus Life Sciences (cactuslifesciences.com) is a leading medical communication company headquartered in Princeton, NJ, with nine global offices. Its expertise lies in delivering scientific content across the product lifecycle with a focus on science, innovation, and efficiency. The company specializes in providing impactful medical strategy, custom operational models, content development and dissemination, and promotion of patient inclusion for biopharmaceutical organizations. Cactus Life Sciences’ scalable solutions cater to the challenges encountered in product development, guiding brands, and organizations towards their future objectives. With a client\-centric approach, the company prioritizes understanding their evolving needs and technology trends to drive its growth. Cactus Life Sciences is a subsidiary of Cactus Communications (cactusglobal.com/), a leading science communication and technology company.

title: Sales Executive – Travel Sales
description:
Sales Executive – Travel Sales

**Rovio Travels \| Noida, Sector 63**  
**Experience:** 0–1 year \| Freshers welcome  
**Salary:** ₹15,000–₹20,000/month \+ performance incentives  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Job Location:** **Sector 63, Noida**

About Rovio Travels

Rovio Travels is a growing travel company building premium travel products for customers across India.

Our business includes **fixed\-departure group tours, premium vehicle rentals, corporate travel and B2B travel partnerships**.

We are expanding our sales team and looking for a **Sales Executive** who is willing to learn, comfortable speaking to customers and motivated by targets and incentives.

About the Role

This is a **core sales role**.

You will speak directly with potential customers and travel partners, understand their requirements, present the right solution, follow up and convert enquiries into bookings.

You will get hands\-on exposure to the complete sales cycle:

**Lead → Conversation → Follow\-up → Negotiation → Booking**

You will also be expected to generate new business through outbound calling and WhatsApp outreach.

What You Will Be Responsible ForLead Conversion

* Handle enquiries received through WhatsApp, website, Meta Ads, Google Ads and other channels
* Call leads promptly and understand their travel requirements
* Qualify leads based on travel dates, group size, budget and requirements
* Recommend the right tour, package or vehicle option
* Explain itineraries, inclusions, pricing and availability clearly
* Follow up consistently until the lead is converted or closed
* Handle objections and negotiate where appropriate
* Convert qualified leads into confirmed bookings

Business Development

* Make outbound calls to potential customers
* Conduct WhatsApp outreach to generate new enquiries
* Reach out to travel agents and tour operators for B2B business
* Build and maintain relationships with prospective partners
* Identify new sales opportunities

Sales Operations

* Maintain accurate lead and follow\-up records
* Update CRM / Excel / Google Sheets regularly
* Track your pipeline and upcoming follow\-ups
* Coordinate with the operations team after a booking is confirmed
* Share feedback on customer objections, pricing and market demand

What We Are Looking ForFreshers are welcome.

You don't need previous travel\-industry experience.

We are looking for someone who is:

* Confident speaking with people over the phone
* Comfortable initiating conversations with strangers
* Fluent in **Hindi and English**
* A good listener who can understand customer requirements
* Persistent with follow\-ups
* Comfortable working with sales targets
* Willing to learn and improve continuously
* Organized enough to manage multiple leads
* Comfortable using WhatsApp, Excel/Google Sheets and basic computer applications

The Right Mindset Matters More Than Experience

We can teach you our products and sales process.

What we cannot teach easily is the willingness to **pick up the phone, follow up, handle rejection and keep going**.

You should be someone who:

**Takes initiative**  
You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do with every lead.

**Likes talking to people**  
You are comfortable having conversations and building rapport.

**Is persistent**  
You understand that the first conversation does not always result in a booking.

**Is commercially minded**  
You care about results, not just completing tasks.

**Wants to grow in sales**  
You see this as a career opportunity, not just a temporary job.

What You Will Learn

You will get practical exposure to:

* Lead qualification
* Consultative selling
* Sales calls
* WhatsApp sales
* Follow\-up systems
* Objection handling
* Negotiation
* Closing techniques
* CRM and pipeline management
* B2B business development
* Travel product sales

Performance \& Growth

Your performance will be measured through metrics such as:

* Leads handled
* Follow\-ups completed
* Conversion rate
* Bookings generated
* Revenue generated
* New business opportunities

**Compensation:** ₹15,000–₹20,000/month \+ performance incentives.

High performers will have the opportunity to take on greater responsibility and progress towards:

**Sales Executive → Senior Sales Executive → Business Development / Sales Manager**

Why Join Rovio Travels?

This role is suitable for someone who wants to learn **real sales**, not simply sit behind a desk and process enquiries.

You will get exposure to customers, negotiations, pricing, B2C sales, B2B sales and the commercial side of a growing travel business.

Your results will be visible.

Your learning curve will be steep.

And your growth will depend largely on the value you create.

This Role Is Not For You If...

* You are uncomfortable making phone calls
* You dislike sales targets
* You prefer a purely desk\-based support role
* You don't like following up with customers
* You are looking for a role with minimal customer interaction

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

description:
If your Instagram collection has a lot of saved reels, your notes app is full of hooks you thought of at 1 a.m., and you've already mentally storyboarded three ideas while reading this, this role is built for you.

EXPERIENCE: Fresher 0 to 6 months

SALARY: Industry standard

TYPE: Full\-time

REPORTS TO: Founder

LOCATION: Andheri (w), Mumbai (onsite)

SCHEDULE: 10 am to 7:30 pm. 6 days working, Mon \& Thu WFO, the other 4 days are either shoot days or WFH

**\>ABOUT 9AV CREATIVE**

9AV Creative is an early\-stage startup, Mumbai\-based digital creative agency that's been building brands for 3 years\+. We act as a strategic plus execution partner to D2C brands to drive content\-led growth, across performance to brand storytelling, using both AI \& live\-action content. Have done it for brands like Upnourish, Pluckk, Ugaoo, Conscious Chemist, Urban Platter, BOHECO, etc.

Website: www.9av.in

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/9av\_creative/

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/9avcreative/

Email: hiring@9av.in

**\>ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are looking for an absolute content obsessive who bridges the gap between scroll\-stopping visuals and hard data. As our Creative Strategist, you will be the creative anchor for multiple brands, writing scripts, defining the visuals, and stepping onto the set to bring those ideas to life. You will not only conceptualise the creative but also function as a performance marketer—diving into Meta Ads Manager dashboards to understand exactly how your creatives are driving revenue and tweaking your strategy based on the numbers. So numbers to concept to production to numbers

Because 9AV Creative is an early\-stage startup, this is a high\-responsibility environment. The weight of the following responsibilites will rest squarely on your shoulders.

**\>WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* **Content angles \& visual packaging:** research and come up with distinct content ideas and angles for each brand, and decide how each one should look (format, pacing, visual style) before it's shot
* **Scripts \& visuals:** research the product and the target audience to write scripts and rough visual direction (shot lists, references, mood boards) that a production team can actually execute
* **On\-set direction:** be present on shoot days to make sure execution stays true to the original idea — catching drift before it becomes a wasted shoot day
* **Trend \& culture scan:** spend real time scrolling Instagram and YouTube, tracking what other creators and competitor brands are doing, what's landing and what's dying, and feeding that into fresh angles
* **Performance feedback loop:**  pull up Meta Ads Manager for the creatives you've shaped and read the numbers: hook rate, CTR, LPV, ATC, CVR, ROAS. Know which ideas are actually converting, not just which ones feel clever
* **Cross\-brand thinking**: juggle creative strategy for multiple client brands at once, adapting tone and format to each one
* **Startup Hustle \& Evolving Duties:** Demonstrate a strong willingness to take ownership across various functions. As we grow, our roles are constantly evolving, meaning you must be open to stepping outside your official scope to get a project to the finish line.

**\>WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* **The Idea Machine:** A talent who is bursting with ideas and genuinely excited about content creation, ads, and marketing. Lives on Instagram not casually, but professionally. You know why a reel works within the first 3 seconds
* **The Data\-Backed Creative:** You do not just rely on gut feelings; you understand numbers, embrace analytics, and actively want to know the CTR and ROAS behind the content you make.
* **The Writer\-Director:** You have an eye for design and framing, love to write punchy hooks, and have the confidence to communicate your vision to a production team.
* **The Internet Native:** You are natively fluent in social media formats, internet culture, and consumer behaviour.
* **The Adaptable Generalist:** You are highly adaptable and understand that in a very small company, your willingness to handle multiple capacities is vital to early success.

**\>WHY JOIN 9AV?**

You will not be a tiny cog in a massive corporate machine. As a foundational team member at 9AV Creative, your work will have an immediate, visible impact on the agency's early success. You will get hands\-on experience in every facet of creative production, performance marketing, and startup building—creating a formidable portfolio from day one.

* Real client brands from day one, not internal practice projects
* Direct mentorship from the founder, who's still hands\-on in creative direction
* Ownership across the full arc of an idea — from concept to camera to final cut
* A small team (4–5 people) where your ideas visibly move the needle

**Company: Gulf To World Group LLP (Gulf To World Consultants)**  
**Location: Chhatarpur, New Delhi — 110074 (Full\-Time \| On\-Site)**  
**Salary: Competitive Fixed \+ 10% Commission \+ Daily / Weekly / Monthly Incentives**

**About Gulf To World Group LLP**

Gulf To World Group LLP is one of India's fastest\-growing immigration consultancies — operating from New Delhi, India and Doha, Qatar. We specialise in Europe Work Permits (Poland, Czech Republic, Croatia, Serbia, Malta), Canada Permanent Residency, Australia Skilled Migration, Portugal D2 Entrepreneur Visa, and Investment Immigration pathways.

We are expanding rapidly and looking for experienced, driven, and target\-oriented Immigration Consultants who are ready to grow with a company that is scaling aggressively in 2026 and beyond.

If you have been in immigration sales — you know the difference between a company that has real products and one that makes promises. At Gulf To World — we have real European employer partnerships, licensed European placement partners, a signed client agreement with a refund clause, and a growing brand. You will be selling something you can be proud of.

**The Role**

As an Immigration Consultant at Gulf To World, your primary responsibility is to convert warm and inbound leads into enrolled clients. You will handle end\-to\-end client consultation — from initial assessment to agreement signing and payment collection. You will work on Europe Work Permits, Canada PR, and Australia PR pathways — and will be supported by a dedicated operations and case management team so you can stay focused purely on sales and client relationship.

**What You Will Do**

* Conduct in\-person and video consultations with prospective clients — walk\-ins, phone leads, and digital inquiries

**What We Are Looking For**

* Minimum 1 to 5 years of hands\-on experience in immigration consultancy sales

* Strong understanding of immigration pathways — not just scripts — real product knowledge
* Excellent client communication skills — Hindi and English — confident and persuasive
* Experience handling objections, follow\-ups, and closing in a target\-driven environment
* Self\-motivated, disciplined, and accountable — someone who owns their pipeline
* Comfortable with CRM tools, WhatsApp\-based lead management, and daily reporting

**Compensation Structure**

We believe in rewarding performance generously and transparently. Here is exactly what you earn:

**Fixed Salary**  
Competitive monthly fixed component — discussed at interview based on experience

**10% Flat Commission**  
10% commission on every deal you close — paid on actual collection — no cap, no ceiling. The more you close, the more you earn. A consultant closing Rs. 10 Lakh in a month earns Rs. 1 Lakh in commission alone.

**Daily Incentives**  
Hit your daily call and consultation targets — earn daily cash bonuses. Small wins every day keep the momentum going.

**Weekly Incentives**  
Close a set number of deals in a week — earn a weekly performance bonus on top of your commission. Consistency is rewarded every Friday.

**Monthly Incentives**  
Top performer of the month earns a special monthly bonus — in addition to all commission and weekly incentives. Monthly recognition, cash reward, and public acknowledgement within the team.

**Additional Perks and Benefits**

* Fast\-track career growth — G2W is scaling rapidly — branch manager and team lead roles open for top performers
* Sponsored immigration knowledge training — upskill on Canada, Australia, Europe, and investment visas
* Team outings, celebrations, and recognition events
* Performance\-based international exposure opportunities — Qatar office and partner country visits
* Supportive team environment — operations handles the paperwork so you handle the clients
* Real products — real employer partnerships — real work permits — sell with confidence

**Why Gulf To World Group LLP**

* Two\-country registered company — India and Qatar — growing brand
* Real European licensed placement partner — genuine work permit products
* Stage\-wise client payment — written agreement — refund clause — products clients trust
* High inbound lead volume — you spend your time selling, not cold calling endlessly
* Transparent incentive structure — no hidden clauses, no delayed payouts
* Management that invests in people — training, tools, and support provided

**IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER — PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING**

**This role is strictly for candidates with existing, hands\-on experience in the immigration consultancy industry.**

We are not looking for freshers, career changers, or candidates from adjacent industries such as banking, insurance, real estate, or education — regardless of how strong their sales background is.

You must have direct experience selling immigration services — specifically Europe Work Permits, Canada PR, or Australia PR — to Indian clients. If you have not done this before, this is not the right opportunity for you at this time and your application will not be processed.

title: Product Manager
description:
Lumenci is building and scaling an agentic AI platform (iLumos) with a suite of internal B2B products focused on patent analysis and legal workflows. As we transition from proof\-of\-concept to production deployment, we need a Product Manager who can drive disciplined execution while navigating the unique challenges of AI\-powered systems. This role sits at the intersection of LLMs, workflow automation, and specialized legal/IP domain knowledge \- ideal for someone who wants to shape how AI delivers real value in complex professional workflows.
   

  

**Responsibilities And Duties** 
  

  

* Product Execution \& Delivery
+ Drive sprint execution as Scrum Master: facilitate planning, standups, retrospectives, and backlog grooming
+ Translate user stories and technical requirements into clear PRDs, epics, and acceptance criteria
+ Maintain delivery momentum across internal engineering teams and external partners

* AI Product Development
+ Prototype and validate agentic workflows alongside AI engineers and domain experts
+ Test LLM outputs for reliability, accuracy, and domain\-specific quality (e.g., patent claim analysis, prior art mapping)
+ Design evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance against user expectations

* Problem\-Solving \& Quality
+ Apply structured thinking (5 Whys, root\-cause analysis) to diagnose feature gaps and system failures
+ Balance speed with quality—know when to ship fast vs. when to validate deeply
+ Track metrics that matter users onboarded, feature adoption, user satisfaction.

* Documentation \& Knowledge Management
+ Build scalable product documentation: decision logs, workflow diagrams, onboarding guides
+ Ensure alignment between strategic goals (OKRs) and day\-to\-day execution
+ Create transparency for stakeholders on progress, blockers, and trade\-offs


**Education And Experience** 
  

  

* Core Product Skills
+ 2\-3 years in product management or related roles
+ Strong understanding of agile/lean product development
+ Proven ability to move from ambiguous problems to shipped features
+ Experience writing clear requirements that engineers can act on immediately

* AI/LLM Familiarity
+ Working knowledge of how LLMs behave in production (hallucinations, prompt sensitivity, latency)
+ Exposure to RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) workflows or vector search concepts
+ Hands\-on curiosity: comfortable testing prompts, evaluating agent outputs, or light "vibe coding"
+ Bonus: Understanding of evaluation metrics for LLM quality (precision, recall, human\-in\-the\-loop)

* Startup Mindset
+ Thrives in lean, high\-ownership environments with evolving priorities
+ Comfortable wearing multiple hats and solving problems outside traditional PM scope
+ Energized by rapid learning curves and cross\-functional collaboration
+ Bias toward action—ships incrementally rather than waiting for perfection

* Communication \& Collaboration
+ Works effectively with AI engineers, backend developers, domain experts, and external vendors
+ Communicates decisions clearly with supporting rationale (written and verbal)
+ Actively listens to user feedback and translates it into actionable insights

* Domain Knowledge (Nice to Have)
+ Familiarity with intellectual property, patent law, or legal workflows
+ Understanding of patent invalidation strategies (novelty, obviousness, etc.) and Infringement analysis
+ Background in legal tech, IP, or other specialized B2B domains


**An ideal candidate would share our way of working**
* Solve for the Customer: Lumenci is a customer\-first company, with the focus to create a long\-term relationship with our clients. Customers here include internal employees and candidates who are part of the recruitment process.
* Quality, Ownership and Accountability: We are passionate about results and take full ownership of our work. We are performance oriented and have a drive for excellence.
* Collaboration: We encourage collaboration over competition, work in small teams and believe that teams do better than individuals.
* Growth Mindset: We are adaptable to changing requirements and needs of a dynamic high growth company. We encourage each other to take diverse initiatives and develop new competencies.


**Who Will Thrive Here?**
* Enjoy building AI products from 0→1 and beyond
* Are intellectually curious about how agent systems work (and where they fail)
* Value tight feedback loops between users, engineering, and product decisions
* Want to work on products that combine cutting\-edge AI with real\-world expertise
* Are comfortable with ambiguity but bring structure to chaos


**About Lumenci**
 Lumenci is the technology industry’s most strategic legal assets monetization partner. We work with the world’s top technology companies, law firms, inventors, deep tech start\-ups, and specialty funds to find the value in their inventions and legal assets and help them pursue—and defend—that value throughout the monetization lifecycle. We work with a wide variety of technologies including hardware and software, telecom, networking, and semiconductor technologies. Lumenci combines technology domain expertise with strategic industry connections to guide towards the best route to ROI. From ideation to monetization \-\- we illuminate the way.

title: Technical Inspection Associate – Power & Infrastructure
description:
**Company:** BetterDrones  
**Location:** Noida – Sector 62  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 0–2 Years  
**Salary:** ₹15,000–₹20,000 per month, based on technical aptitude and assessment  
**Training Period:** 6 Months  
**PPO Opportunity:** Yes, based on performance during the training period

**About BetterDrones**

BetterDrones is a drone\-based technology company working across the Power and Infrastructure sectors. We use Visual, Thermal and LiDAR drone data to inspect electrical and infrastructure assets and generate technical inspection insights.

Our work includes transmission lines, electrical poles, substations, railway/OHE infrastructure, metro infrastructure, solar assets and other critical infrastructure.

**About the Role**

This is **not a conventional data\-entry or AI data\-annotation role**.

As a **Technical Inspection Associate**, you will work on drone\-captured Visual, Thermal and LiDAR data and support the technical inspection of power and infrastructure assets.

You will be trained to understand infrastructure components, identify visible defects and anomalies, interpret inspection data and accurately mark observations in the company's inspection workflow.

The role is primarily computer\-based and requires strong observation, technical understanding, concentration and attention to detail.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Review drone\-captured Visual, Thermal and LiDAR imagery of power and infrastructure assets.

· Identify and mark defects, abnormalities, missing components and other inspection observations.

· Understand basic electrical and infrastructure components and their functions.

· Annotate and classify assets and defects according to project\-specific inspection standards.

· Perform detailed visual inspection of transmission lines, poles, electrical components, OHE, railway/metro and solar infrastructure.

· Compare captured data with inspection standards, checklists and project requirements.

· Perform quality checks on annotated inspection data.

· Maintain accuracy, consistency and proper documentation of project outputs.

· Coordinate with Inspection, GIS and Operations teams regarding project requirements and observations.

· Learn and follow BetterDrones' technical inspection SOPs and quality standards.

· Complete assigned inspection work within defined timelines and quality requirements.

**Who Should Apply**

We are primarily looking for candidates with a technical background who are willing to build a career in infrastructure inspection and drone\-based technology.

**Preferred Qualification**

· Diploma in Electrical Engineering

· Diploma in Electrical \& Electronics Engineering

· Diploma in Electronics Engineering

· Diploma in Instrumentation Engineering

· ITI Electrician with good computer skills

· Diploma in Civil/Surveying with strong technical aptitude may also be considered

**Freshers are welcome to apply.**

**Required Skills**

· Good basic computer skills

· Comfortable working continuously on a computer

· Strong observation and attention to detail

· Ability to identify differences, abnormalities and defects

· Basic understanding of electrical/electronic components

· Ability to understand technical instructions

· Good concentration and patience for repetitive technical inspection work

· Willingness to learn power\-sector and infrastructure inspection concepts

· Ability to work with targets and deadlines

· Responsible and disciplined approach to work

**Important: Nature of Work**

This role involves substantial computer\-based technical inspection and annotation work.

Candidates should be comfortable with:

· Repetitive technical inspection

· Detailed visual checking

· Working on a computer for extended periods

· Following technical SOPs

· Working with accuracy and defined productivity targets

· Learning new technical concepts

· Working in a fast\-paced startup environment

**This position is not suitable for candidates looking specifically for software development, coding, AI/ML development or purely field\-based electrical work.**

**6\-Month Training Period \& PPO Opportunity**

The selected candidate will initially undergo a **6\-month structured Training \& Development Period**.

During this period, candidates will receive practical training and hands\-on exposure to:

· Power infrastructure fundamentals

· Transmission line and electrical asset components

· Defect identification

· Drone\-based visual inspection

· Visual, Thermal and LiDAR inspection data

· Inspection and annotation standards

· Quality control procedures

· Project workflows

Candidates will be evaluated throughout the training period based on their **learning ability, technical understanding, accuracy, productivity, discipline, consistency and overall performance**.

**PPO Opportunity :** Candidates who successfully complete the training period and meet the required performance standards may be offered a **Pre\-Placement Offer (PPO)** for a full\-time position with BetterDrones.

**Please note:** Completion of the 6\-month training period does not automatically guarantee a PPO. The PPO will be based on individual performance and business requirements.

**Career Growth**

Performance\-based growth opportunities are available toward roles such as:

**Technical Inspection Associate → Senior Inspection Associate → Quality/Inspection Specialist → Inspection Team Lead → Inspection Manager**

**Interview \& Selection Process**

Our selection process is designed to assess both **technical aptitude and basic computer skills**.

**Round 1 – HR Telephonic Round**

**Round 2 – 5 Minute Inspection Aptitude Test**

Candidates will be shown **power\-sector and infrastructure\-related photographs**.

The candidate will be asked to:

· Identify the infrastructure/electrical component shown

· Name the component wherever possible

· Demonstrate basic technical understanding

· Observe and identify relevant visual details

This round is primarily designed to assess the candidate's **technical awareness, observation ability and learning aptitude**.

**Round 3 – Computer\-Based Test**

**Round 4 – Final Interview**

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* The salary for this position is ₹15,000–₹20,000 per month, depending on technical aptitude and assessment. Are you comfortable with this salary range?
* This position includes a 6\-month structured Training \& Development Period, followed by a PPO opportunity based on performance. Are you comfortable with this structure?
* The job is full\-time and work\-from\-office in Noida Sector 62\. Are you comfortable working from this location?
* What is your highest relevant technical qualification?
* How would you describe your understanding of basic electrical/electronic components?
* The role requires reviewing a large number of technical images every day and performing repetitive inspection/annotation work while maintaining accuracy. Are you comfortable with this?
* How soon can you join BetterDrones if selected?

***NEWCOLD BHARAT REEFER PRIVATE LIMITED***

**ABOUT NEWCOLD** 




 NewCold is a service provider in cold chain logistics with a focus on development and operation of large, highly automated cold stores. NewCold strives to be crucial in the cold chain of leading food companies, by offering advanced logistic services worldwide. NewCold is one of the fastest growing companies (over 3,000 employees) in the cold chain logistics and they are expanding teams to support this growth. They use the latest technology that empowers people, to handle food responsibly and guarantee food safety in a sustainable way. They challenge the industry, believe in long\-term partnerships, and deliver solid investment opportunities that enable next generation logistic solutions. NewCold has leading market in\-house expertise in designing, engineering, developing and operating state\-of\-the\-art automated cold stores: a result of successful development and operation of over 25 automated warehouses across three continents. With the prospect of many new construction projects around the world in the very near future, this vacancy offers an interesting opportunity to join an internationally growing and ambitious organization.
 



  





**Role Purpose:** 




 As a Junior Project Manager – Energy Projects at NewCold, you will support the Energy \& Sustainability team in advancing global energy projects. The role supports the structured planning, coordination, execution, and closure of projects across NewCold. The person will help to translate project objectives into clear plans, maintains control of schedules, actions, risks, budgets, and documentation, and coordinates contributors to keep delivery on track. Candidate will Work closely with Project Managers and cross\-functional teams, to provide reliable project information, to follow through on commitments, and to support timely \& evidence\-based decisions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Support the planning, coordination, and execution of projects in line with agreed scope, schedule, budget, quality requirements, and business objectives.
* Work independently as project manager across the project lifecycle, from problem definition and concept development through implementation, handover, and close\-out.
* Develop and maintain project schedules, trackers, action registers, decision logs, project documentation, and status reports.
* Coordinate with internal teams, site representatives, vendors, contractors, consultants, and suppliers to support timely completion of project activities.
* Organize project meetings, prepare agendas and minutes, document decisions, track action owners and deadlines, and follow up to closure.
* Support project governance, including risk and issue management, dependency tracking, change control, document control, and compliance with internal processes.
* Gather, validate, and analyse project data to identify trends, inconsistencies, delays, cost variances, and areas requiring management attention.
* Prepare business cases, approval papers, evaluations, project presentations, dashboards, management reports, and executive summaries.
* Support sourcing and vendor\-management activities, including requirements clarification, proposal review, bid comparison, onboarding coordination, and performance monitoring.
* Monitor project budgets, commitments, purchase orders, invoices, forecasts, and expenditure against approved plans, and highlight variances promptly.
* Identify delivery risks, constraints, and improvement opportunities, and work with responsible stakeholders to define and track mitigation or corrective actions.
* Promote clear accountability by confirming ownership, escalating unresolved matters appropriately, and ensuring that agreed deliverables are followed through.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of project management tools, templates, reporting standards, lessons learned, and ways of working.
* Remain informed about relevant developments in project management, technology, operations, and the business areas connected to assigned projects.



  





**Job Requirements:** 





 Education Requirement:
 



* Bachelor's degree in engineering, business administration, operations, information systems, or another relevant discipline.
* 2\-5 years of experience in project coordination, project management, PMO, operations, technology, engineering, construction, logistics, consulting, or another project\-based environment.
* Practical experience supporting schedules, documentation, reporting, meetings, actions, risks, budgets, or vendors within a project or programme.
* Working knowledge of project management and collaboration tools such as Microsoft Project, Jira, Planner, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, or equivalent platforms is preferred.



  






 Skills \& Competencies:
 



* Sound understanding of project management principles, including planning, scheduling, scope, stakeholder coordination, risk management, change control, and project controls.
* Ownership mindset with the initiative to identify gaps, clarify next steps, and drive assigned actions to completion with limited supervision.
* Strong analytical ability, including confidence in working with structured and unstructured data, checking accuracy, and converting findings into clear recommendations.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain attention to detail, and remain dependable in a fast\-moving, international environment.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to summarize complex project information for both working teams and senior management.
* Effective stakeholder and vendor coordination skills, including professional follow\-up, expectation management, and constructive issue resolution.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, and Teams; familiarity with reporting or data\-visualization tools is an advantage.
* Collaborative, structured, pragmatic, and comfortable working across functions, cultures, and time zones.



  





**Why Work for NewCold?** 




 NewCold is a key global player in advanced cold chain logistics, known for designing and operating fully automated, high\-tech warehouses that transform how food supply chain functions. Our key achievement lies in integrating automation, proprietary technology, and sustainability into a single operating model. We have also established Newcold as an innovation leader by leveraging AI, robotics, and data\-driven systems to deliver end‑to‑end supply chain visibility and efficiency. Sustainability is embedded into our core strategy, with engagement of renewable energy, automation, and next\-generation logistics solutions to build more resilient and responsible value chains. We have the ambition and potential to become the global market leader in modern and automated temperature\-controlled logistics. Although our proposition includes an attractive benefit and compensation package, the international scope and impact of the position may appeal to you even more.

 Candidates residing in nearby locations viz;
 **Thanisandra, Hebbal, Yelahanka, Nagawara, Sahakar Nagar, Manyata Tech Park, Hegde Nagar or Jakkur** 
 will be preferred.

 We are looking for a

 As a
 **Project Support Coordinator – Language Specialist** 
 , you will provide administrative and technical support to global project teams, independently planning, organizing, and coordinating assigned responsibilities.
   

  

 You will support initial study setup and ongoing study maintenance, maintain systems and database repositories, complete data entry, prepare reports, and collect data for analysis and review.
   

  

 You will also contribute to audit readiness, risk management, process improvement initiatives, and effective communication across project teams. Depending on your experience and assignment, you may act as a key point of contact for the Project Lead (PL) or Clinical Team Manager (CTM) and provide coordination support to junior Project Support Coordinators.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Coordinate, oversee, and complete assigned clinical trial activities in accordance with the applicable task matrix.
* Support the initial study setup and ongoing maintenance of study\-specific systems, tools, trackers, and documentation.
* Perform department, internal, country, and investigator file reviews assigned, document findings, follow up on resolutions, and escalate issues when necessary.
* Ensure assigned activities are completed on time, within budget, and according to established quality standards.
* Support study\-specific documentation and maintain key trackers, including study team lists, project\-specific training requirements, system access management, and project\-level activity plans.
* Provide support for clinical trial systems such as CTMS, Oracle Activate, and eTMF, including access requests, study\-level document tracking, audit readiness, and follow\-up on non\-compliance.
* Coordinate and organize client and/or internal meetings, including scheduling, preparation and distribution of meeting minutes, and follow\-up on action items where required.
* Export and reconcile study metrics reports and, where applicable, analyze information and identify potential issues.

title: Product Designer (UI/UX)
description:
**Lyzr, in a minute**
 Lyzr is an enterprise software company that helps large organisations put AI agents software that handles real tasks on its own to work in their everyday operations. Most companies' AI projects never move past the pilot stage; Lyzr provides the platform that takes them into dependable, day\-to\-day use. Today, 500\+ enterprises build on Lyzr, more than 1,000 agents run live in production, and 85% of Lyzr projects reach production against an industry average of roughly 30%. Customers include Accenture, WTW, Hitachi, and Verifone, and the company recently raised $100M at a $500M valuation.
   

  

 Agentic software has no settled design language yet. How a person delegates work to an agent, follows what it did, and decides whether to trust the result are questions the industry is still answering. This role sits directly on those questions.
   

  

**The role**
 You will design the surfaces enterprise teams use to build, run, and supervise AI agents. This is a product design role, not a visual execution role: you will be handed problems, not specifications, and you will be expected to frame them before you open Figma.
   

  

 You will join a small design team, which means real scope from week one and no queue between you and the product decisions that matter.
   

  

* Team: Product
* Experience: 2–4 years
* Location \& work mode: Bengaluru, hybrid


**What Will Make You Win This Role**
 These are the core requirements the substance of the job.
   

  

* 2–4 years in product design, UI/UX, or interaction design. Shipped product work, not concept work. We will look at what went live and what changed because of it.
* Product thinking, evidenced. You can walk us through a problem you were given, how you framed it, the options you rejected, and why the version that shipped was the right one. Craft matters; judgement matters more.
* B2B SaaS, enterprise, or AI product experience. You have designed for users who are doing their job in your product, under constraints permissions, workflows, data density, edge cases not for consumers browsing.
* Interaction design and information architecture depth. Complex systems, dense states, and multi\-step flows are where you are strongest. You think in systems, not screens.
* Fluent in Figma and modern prototyping tools. Figma at a production standard, plus whatever you use to make an idea feel real before it is built.
* Curiosity about AI and emerging interaction patterns. You have opinions about how people should work with agents, and you are actively forming them.


**Cherry on top**
 Not screening criteria but they will make your first 90 days smoother.
   

  

* AI\-native product design. You have designed agents, copilots, chat, or automation workflows and know where the usual patterns break.
* AI in your own design process. You use it to move faster and explore wider, and you can show where it helped and where it did not.
* 0→1 experience. You have built something from nothing inside a startup or a new product line.
* Design systems. You have built or scaled one, and you understand the maintenance cost as well as the leverage.
* A view on AI trust and transparency. Agent behaviour, explainability, human\-in\-the\-loop control you have thought about what earns a user's confidence.


**Life at Lyzr**
* Benefits. Zomato meal allowance, an extensive PTO policy, and company\-paid subscriptions to leading AI tools you work with the same tooling our customers rely on.
* Hybrid structure. Office days for collaboration and team problem\-solving; remote days for deep, uninterrupted work.
* An exceptional team. You will work alongside genuinely strong engineers and operators the kind of colleagues who raise the level of everyone around them.
* Autonomy and ownership. We hire people who think like founders. You are given a problem and the space to drive your own outcomes and with them, your own growth.
* Everybody is a visionary. Ideas are evaluated on merit, not seniority. You lead projects, make decisions, and shape what Lyzr becomes.


**How To Apply**
 Apply through our careers page at careers.lyzr.ai, or send your resume to hiring@lyzr.ai. Send your portfolio with it we read those first. Two or three case studies you can defend end to end will tell us more than a gallery of screens.

title: Financial Analyst
description:
HMH is a learning technology company committed to delivering connected solutions that engage learners, empower educators and improve student outcomes. As a leading provider of K–12 core curriculum, supplemental and intervention solutions, and professional learning services, HMH partners with educators and school districts to uncover solutions that unlock students’ potential and extend teachers’ capabilities.
   

  

 HMH serves more than 50 million students and 4 million educators in 150 countries. For more information, visit www.hmhco.com
   

  

 HMH is seeking a detail\-oriented
 **Financial Analyst** 
 to support Finance teams across revenue and expense reporting, enterprise reporting, recurring monthly financial processes, data management, and financial data validation.
   

  

 This role is well suited for an early\-career finance professional who enjoys working with data, executing repeatable processes accurately and on time, and improving the tools and documentation that support Finance operations. The Financial Analyst will work across multiple recurring Finance processes and partner with analysts and Finance leaders to help ensure financial information is complete, accurate, timely, and presentation\-ready.
   

  

 The position will also provide opportunities to build skills in Excel, Power BI, enterprise reporting, financial systems, process improvement, and financial analysis.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Process monthly expense service entries and associated supporting documentation for Financial Business Partner leads.
* Refresh monthly enterprise financial reporting presentations and dashboards, ensuring underlying data, charts, tables, commentary, and formatting are accurate and current.
* Assist with month\-end reporting processes and preparation of financial information for internal stakeholders.
* Perform daily financial validation activities to identify missing, inconsistent, or inaccurate financial information.
* Support financial data management activities across reporting files, systems, and dashboards.
* Maintain, modify, and enhance Excel\-based Finance files, models, and reporting templates.
* Develop, maintain, and improve clear process documentation, procedures, checklists, and supporting materials for recurring Finance activities.
* Communicate identified data issues, process concerns, and reporting discrepancies clearly and promptly.
* Demonstrate accountability for assigned tasks and consistently meet established deadlines.


**What You’ll Need**
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 0–2 years of experience in Finance, Accounting, financial reporting, data analysis, or a related area.
* Strong attention to detail with a commitment to producing accurate, high\-quality work.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including formulas, lookups, pivot tables, data manipulation, and spreadsheet formatting.
* Ability to work with large data sets and perform detailed data validation and reconciliation.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple recurring assignments and deadlines.
* Ability to follow documented processes while also identifying opportunities to improve them.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced Finance environment


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Internship or professional experience in FP\&A, Finance, Accounting, financial reporting, or business analytics.
* Exposure to enterprise financial systems or planning/reporting platforms such as Power BI, SAP, Anaplan, Oracle, PeopleSoft, or similar tools.
* Experience creating or maintaining process documentation.
* Familiarity with month\-end close, financial reconciliations, revenue reporting, expense reporting, or audit support.
* Interest in developing advanced Excel, financial systems, reporting automation, and data visualization capabilities.

Our ambition is to be a digital leader through innovation and develop and deliver leading edge technology such as robotic process automation and artificial intelligence to solve some of HMH’s greatest operational business challenges. Our professionals will have business relevant skills to connect our HMH partners to technologies that propel the businesses to deliver the greatest value for HMH and our customers.

Our team will find ways to work together, create a sense of community where it’s safe to take risks and learn together, develop our careers, and all have an opportunity to work on new technologies. We will work together, learn together and have fun together. As a team, we will lead HMH’s digital transformation.

description:
What you'll do
 


* —Run onboarding for new joiners: paperwork, accounts, the first\-week plan

* —Answer the routine questions people bring to HR, and know which ones to escalate
* —Coordinate interviews, inductions and internal sessions

* —Help run engagement activities without them quietly becoming your whole job



 What success looks like
 


* —In your first 30 days: onboarded your first joiners with someone checking your work
* —In your first 30 days: know where every record lives and who owns it
* —By 60 days: running onboarding end to end on your own
* —By 60 days: producing the weekly headcount and joining report without being asked
* —By 90 days: trusted with a process of your own from start to finish
* —By 90 days: fixed one thing about how we do it that was quietly wasting time



 What we're looking for
 


* —Written communication — writes a short, clear message a candidate or a hiring manager can act on without needing a reply
* —Coordination — keeps a process with several people and dates in it from slipping
* —Fairness and policy awareness — notices a question or a criterion that should not be used, and says so
* —Learning speed — picks up something unfamiliar quickly and can say how they went about it



 Helpful, but not required
 


* —Reading people data — reads a simple headcount or funnel report and sees what it is telling you
* —Ownership — closes the loop without being chased, and says early when something has gone wrong
* —Our applicant tracking system and internal trackers (you can learn this here)
* —How we run intake calls with hiring managers (you can learn this here)
* —Sourcing on LinkedIn Recruiter and Naukri (you can learn this here)
* —Screening conventions for the market you cover (you can learn this here)



 What counts as experience
 



 You do not need a formal job to apply. We look at what you have actually done, wherever you did it.
 


* —Any HR or recruitment internship, however short
* —Placement committee, campus recruitment or student\-body hiring
* —A project where you interviewed, screened or coordinated people
* —Anything you have used an AI assistant for, and what you were trying to do with it



 The practical details
 


* —Internship
* —Pune, Maharashtra · Hybrid
* —₹15,000–₹15,000 per month, plus a performance\-based PPO, indicatively Rs 3\.5\-4\.5 lakh a year
* —12:00 noon to 9:00 pm IST, Monday to Friday.
* —None.
* —You need to be in Pune. We do not pay relocation, so please only apply if you can be here from day one.
* —Joining: Within 7 days of the final conversation

* —₹20,000 annual learning budget
* —Wednesdays remote



 How hiring works here
 



 Your application is read by a person. The assessment helps us see how you think, not how well you write a CV.
 


* —A 15\-minute skills assessment — 8 short questions about the actual work. No trivia.
* —An optional 15–30 second video introduction. Skipping it does not affect your result.
* —A 20\-minute online assessment \- 12 short questions about how you would handle real situations
* —A 20\-minute call with the talent team, focused on how you think and how you speak
* —A conversation with the person you would report to
* —Decision within a week of the final conversation

description:
**Regional HRBP – East \& North East** 




**Departments:** 
 Human Resources
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Head – HRBP
 



**Supporting for:** 
 ASG – East \& North\-East Region – Raipur, Guwahati\-1, Guwahati\-2, Jamshedpur, Ranchi.
 



**Location:** 
 Jamshedpur (Base Location)
 



**Job Description** 




**Role Summary** 




 The Regional HRBP – East \& North East serves as the strategic and operational HR leader for ASG centres across Raipur, Bhubaneswar, Guwahati\-1, Guwahati\-2, Jamshedpur, Ranchi, Dhanbad \& Cuttack, spanning Jharkhand, Odisha, Chhattisgarh and Assam. Based at Jamshedpur, the role drives the end\-to\-end HR lifecycle across the region — talent acquisition, onboarding, performance management, employee engagement, retention, compliance and HR operations.
 



  





 As a strategic business partner, the Regional HRBP collaborates closely with the Functional Head, Regional COO and Head – HRBP to align people strategies with business objectives. Given the geographic spread and the distinct talent markets of the East and North East, the role carries a significant travel and centre\-connect mandate, ensuring consistency of HR practices across all centres, a positive employee experience, and a high\-performance, compliant and engaged workforce that enables clinical and operational excellence.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**A. Strategic HR Business Partnering** 



* Partner with the Functional Head, Regional COO and Head – HRBP to translate business priorities into actionable HR strategies and workforce plans for the East and North East region.
* Serve as the HR business partner to centre heads and regional leadership across all eight locations, ensuring proactive HR interventions for growth and people capability building.
* Provide HR KPI reports and insights for manpower optimisation, productivity improvement and talent preparedness at region and centre level.
* Account for the distinct market dynamics of Jharkhand, Odisha, Chhattisgarh and Assam while designing region\-specific people interventions.



**B. Talent Acquisition \& Onboarding** 




**Recruitment \& Manpower Fulfilment:** 



* Drive end\-to\-end recruitment for all clinical, non\-clinical and support roles across the region, ensuring quality hires within defined TAT.
* Monitor and maintain manpower strength as per approved budgets and operational requirements at each centre.
* Build local talent pipelines for hard\-to\-fill clinical and optometry roles in tier 2 and tier 3 locations through institute tie\-ups, referrals and regional consultants.



**Onboarding \& Separation:** 



* Conduct structured onboarding and induction for new joiners, including HR policy orientation and cultural assimilation.
* Manage employee exit and separation formalities, including exit interviews, clearance and full and final settlement coordination.



**C. Performance Management \& Rewards** 



* Ensure 100% completion of performance management cycles across the region, including goal setting, mid\-year and annual reviews.
* Conduct capability\-building workshops for centre managers to strengthen the performance feedback culture.
* Manage incentive, appraisal and reward programmes, ensuring fairness, internal equity and timeliness across all centres.



**D. Employee Engagement, Retention \& Recognition** 



* Design and implement region\-specific engagement and retention strategies based on employee feedback and attrition trends.
* Conduct at least four engagement or recognition initiatives annually at regional or centre level.
* Develop and implement proactive retention strategies for critical talent and high performers, with particular focus on clinical and optometry cadres.
* Ensure employee grievances are addressed promptly with fair and documented resolution.



**E. Centre Visits \& Employee Connect** 



* Conduct periodic visits to all eight centres as per the monthly travel plan to engage with employees, understand on\-ground challenges and assess HR policy adherence.
* Publish detailed visit reports with actionable insights and ensure closure of follow\-up points.
* Facilitate open forums, skip\-level interactions and town halls to enhance employee communication and visibility across the multi\-location region.
* Maintain regular virtual connect with centres between physical visits to ensure continuous HR presence.



**F. HR Operations \& Compliance** 



* Ensure complete compliance with statutory, legal and healthcare HR norms across all centres and applicable state jurisdictions.
* Maintain HRIS data accuracy (attendance, leave, payroll inputs) at 100% accuracy.
* Drive workforce discipline, attendance management and adherence to HR SOPs.
* Coordinate with internal audit, legal and quality teams for HR process validation.



**G. Manpower Cost \& Productivity** 



* Monitor and control regional manpower cost in line with approved budgets.
* Track and improve workforce productivity, absenteeism and overtime cost across centres.
* Provide monthly cost variance analysis and corrective action recommendations to regional and corporate leadership.



**H. HR Analytics \& Reporting** 



* Publish weekly and monthly HR dashboards covering attrition, headcount, manpower cost and productivity.
* Provide data\-driven insights to leadership for decision\-making on people priorities.
* Maintain documentation and reporting accuracy at 100%.



**I. Stakeholder Management** 



* Build strong relationships with business, operations and clinical leaders to support people\-related decisions.
* Act as a trusted advisor to centre heads on HR strategy, employee issues and organisation development.
* Liaise with corporate HR for policy implementation, compliance and process governance.

description:
***We Are Hiring: Head of Human Resources***




  





**About Elahé** 




 For 30 years, Elahe has been part of Hyderabad's luxury fashion scene, bringing India's finest couture and ready\-to\-wear to discerning clients.
 



 Today, One Elahe LLP brings together seven businesses: Elahe, Elahe Urban, Gallery 476, Oorja, Elahe Online, Amrapali, and Sabyasachi. Its 150\+ strong team spans retail and styling, tailoring and craftsmanship, online, and operations.
 



  





***Location: Hyderabad***




  





**About the Role** 




 As Head of Human Resources, you will be the group's dedicated HR leader. Your first priority is hiring: making sure every business has the right people, at the right time. Alongside that, you will build the HR function from the ground up, including its policies, processes, and eventually its team.
 



 The role calls for a recruiter's instinct and a builder's discipline in equal measure.
 



  





***What you'll do:***




  





***HIRING ACROSS ALL BUSINESSES:***



* Own end\-to\-end hiring for all seven businesses, including sales associates and stylists, store managers, tailors and karigars, the online team, and back\-office roles.
* Work with the founders and business leads to plan headcount and anticipate hiring needs ahead of seasons, launches, and new openings.
* Build reliable sourcing channels, including job portals, fashion and design institutes, referrals, and local networks for skilled craftspeople.
* Run screening, interviews, reference checks, and offers, giving every candidate a fast and polished experience.
* Write and maintain clear job descriptions for every role.



  





***BUILDING THE HR FUNCTION:***



* Set up HR structures, processes, and systems from scratch.
* Build and lead a small HR team as the group's needs grow.
* Create an employee handbook and core policies covering leave, attendance, conduct, dress code, and grievances.
* Introduce an HR system and maintain complete, accurate employee records.



  





***ONBOARDING AND TRAINING:***



* Design a structured induction for new joiners across each business.
* Work with store leads to deliver training in product knowledge and luxury client service.
* Make sure every new hire's first 90 days are well supported.



  





***PAYROLL , COMPLIANCE , AND HR OPERATIONS:***



* Work with the accounts and payroll team to ensure salaries, incentives, and statutory deductions are accurate and on time.
* Own employment contracts, offer letters, and full\-and\-final settlements.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, including PF, ESI, gratuity, Shops and Establishments registrations, and the POSH Act, including setting up the Internal Committee.



  





***PERFORMANCE AND REWARDS:***



* Set up a regular performance review cycle with clear expectations for every role.
* Work with the founders to design fair salary bands and sales incentive structures.



  





***EMPLOYEE RELATIONS AND RETENTION:***



* Be the first point of contact for staff concerns, grievances, and disciplinary matters, handling each fairly and discreetly.
* Track attrition, run exit interviews, and act on what they reveal.
* Build a culture of engagement and recognition across stores, workshops, and teams.



  





***Who you are:***




  




* You have 6 to 10 years of HR experience, including time in retail, luxury, hospitality, or another business with large frontline teams.
* You have a strong track record of hiring at volume, for frontline staff, skilled craftspeople, and professionals alike.
* You're familiar with fashion roles such as fashion consultants and merchandisers, and you understand how luxury retail spaces run and what it takes to succeed in them.
* You have hands\-on knowledge of labour laws and statutory compliance.
* You have set up HR processes before, ideally as an early HR hire in a growing organization.
* You're organized, discreet, and fair, and you earn the trust of both staff and leadership.
* You communicate clearly in English and Hindi. Telugu is an advantage.
* A postgraduate qualification in HR is a plus.



  





***What the role offers:***




  




* The chance to build an HR function from scratch for an established luxury fashion group.
* Direct access to the founders and real influence over how the group grows.
* Exposure to seven distinct businesses across retail, craft, and online.
* Competitive compensation based on experience.

description:
**Designation:** 
 Associate Product Manager
 



**Location:** 
 Bangalore
 



  





 We are looking for a sharp, data\-first APM who can dive deep into planning data, find where the leakages are, and work closely with operations to fix them. This is a hands\-on role: you will spend a good part of your time in SQL and Python, and the rest with warehouse, procurement and category teams turning insights into actual improvements.
 



  





**Responsibilities, aka, what we’d like you to deliver :** 




  





**\-Analytics and Problem Discovery (Core Focus)** 



* Analyse large datasets (orders, inventory, POs, GRNs, stock transfers, wastage) using SQL and Python to identify leakages across availability, DOH and expiry
* Build a deep understanding of
 *why* 
 availability drops or stock expires: forecasting errors, vendor delays, parameter misconfiguration, warehouse bottlenecks, store\-level constraints
* Create and maintain dashboards, alerts and reports that give planning and operations teams reliable visibility
* Run root\-cause analyses on availability misses, high DOH pockets and expiry spikes, and quantify the impact in ₹ terms



**\-Product and Process Improvement** 



* Work with the PM to translate findings into product and system improvements: planning logic, parameters, thresholds, rules and automation
* Write clear problem statements and simple PRDs for changes to planning algorithms and tools
* Support forecasting and replenishment model improvements alongside data science and engineering



**\-Operational Partnership** 



* Work closely with warehouse, darkstore, procurement, category and vendor teams to understand ground realities and constraints
* Visit warehouses and stores when needed to see how things actually work
* Get hands dirty when required: manual analysis, data cleanups, follow\-ups, firefighting during critical periods, and validating system outputs against ground truth
* Drive adoption of process and tool changes with ops teams



  





**What We’re Looking For:** 




  




* **Strong SQL:** 
 comfortable with complex joins, window functions, CTEs and query optimisation on large datasets
* **Strong Python:** 
 hands\-on with pandas, numpy and visualisation libraries for analysis and automation; exposure to basic statistics or forecasting is a plus
* **Analytical mindset:** 
 you break down ambiguous problems, form hypotheses, and go to the data to prove or disprove them
* **Ownership and bias to action:** 
 you are not afraid of grunt work and will dig through messy data or spend a day on the warehouse floor to get to the truth
* **Clear communication:** 
 able to explain a data insight simply to ops teams and senior stakeholders
* **1–3 years of experience** 
 in analytics, business analysis, supply chain, or a similar role (exceptional freshers with relevant internships or projects may be considered)
* Bachelor's degree, preferably in Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics or a related quantitative field



  





**Growth Path** 




  





 Your first phase will be data\-heavy: becoming the go\-to person for planning analytics and problem discovery. Over time, you will be groomed to:
 


* Own problem statements and write PRDs end to end
* Own specific planning modules or verticals (for example, FMCG replenishment or perishables)
* Drive roadmap prioritisation and stakeholder alignment
* Grow into a Product Manager owning a part of the planning product
